skos:Concept.skos:scopeNote: {"id": "9816f2d5-eb57-4c59-9ce5-8e155312dbfc", "value": "A pit in a road or trackway covered with a grid, usually of metal poles (but can be of wood or stone) with sufficient space between the poles to prevent animals from crossing, without restricting access."}

skos:ConceptScheme.dcterms:title: {"id": "6929568d-edea-4315-866e-95b68af10e9a", "value": "MONUMENT TYPE (WALES)"}
skos:ConceptScheme.dcterms:description: {"id": "c44f94d2-f633-4efa-bd23-8f477c2c13c1", "value": "A list of monument types for use in Wales."}

skos:Concept.skos:scopeNote: {"id": "60889abe-528a-46da-80cb-9df1ff54fc0a", "value": "A structure to which a net filled with mail bags is attached. Situated next to railway lines, it allows mail to be collected by a train without it stopping, the bag being 'caught' by the train as it passed. Can also be used to 'catch' mail."}
{"id": "b8d6f69b-33e8-4e0a-a92f-100a8f26e215", "value": "A controlled point with warning lights and gates or barriers where a road crosses a railway line."}
{"id": "cef2a0e7-6e8d-41c2-878f-43134418c7ee", "value": "A house for the keeper of a level crossing on a railway."}
{"id": "85b23fda-8ea4-4c3e-ba1d-426dc579df14", "value": "A model village built in association with a factory, mill, railway, or any other industrial complex; usually built by the employer."}
{"id": "b62b1702-756b-4dfe-bf72-84c90147020b", "value": "A building used by the church to promote Christianity through lectures, study, etc."}
{"id": "b01c906e-16d3-45ca-a80a-15be31fcc95b", "value": "An area of a building providing reading materials for the benefit of working men."}
{"id": "3188181b-41c3-4b83-b4bc-3a55c8344650", "value": "An area of a building providing reading materials for the benefit of colliery workers."}
{"id": "3d93d068-da1e-4eeb-99aa-fd7578cd2c10", "value": "A building where miners could improve their knowledge by attending lectures and using the reading room facilities."}
{"id": "877d1c91-3a52-42c1-b3e4-65212bf8870b", "value": "A place where working men could educate themselves through lectures and the use of a reading room with newspapers, etc."}
{"id": "ac02c4ac-44cd-4996-97dd-2b075df8ad95", "value": "A building or site used to produce alkaline chemicals by controlled reactions."}

{"id": "f1d400a7-ef51-4a6f-9d3f-53b2ae991ff7", "value": "A slight structure built for shelter or storage, or for use as a workshop, either attached as a lean-to to a permanent building or separate. Use more specific type where known."}
{"id": "854e94ea-bcc6-4171-8e1c-9fccc5d0396c", "value": "A building used to store coal."}
{"id": "ea4b6d1e-6983-455f-839e-238044c13e2f", "value": "A managed small wood or thicket of underwood grown to be periodically cut to encourage new growth providing smaller timber."}
{"id": "a3781747-1456-46d0-96ed-8214d0d05fbf", "value": "An earthen bank indicating the limit of a wood or coppice"}
{"id": "13058c4f-57b9-4d41-a69e-c2462592c9b6", "value": "A hall licensed for musical performances, singing, dancing and other entertainments, exclusive of dramatic performance."}
{"id": "5c7f4d5a-f9ab-4b23-9e13-f296fef882e6", "value": "An establishment where musical performances take place."}
{"id": "b62ed3c3-ac49-4be6-a759-b9ad942d7502", "value": "A building used primarily for the performing of plays."}

{"id": "9c473a7d-266c-405b-9c38-b414c23da614", "value": "A manufacturing complex where the hides of animals are turned into leather, consisting of buildings for fleecing and drying, as well as treatment pits."}
{"id": "11fc6895-470a-441d-ab69-31305c0cc807", "value": "A building where animals are slaughtered."}
{"id": "137b361c-9868-48ab-b862-e272a409ac95", "value": "A building used to smoke fish or meat."}
{"id": "413c9442-5f33-4e4d-9526-570dc2307916", "value": "A place where coal is mined."}
{"id": "1730ebc5-2d32-484b-ad05-1656d67b6f4a", "value": "A building containing the colliery showers. Also often containing first aid and mine rescue facilities."}
{"id": "364604c9-19cf-4416-b876-7b783d57fc14", "value": "A site where coal is extracted. Use with form of extraction where known eg. BELL PIT."}
{"id": "622d7162-0fdb-4bda-be35-d018c34ee7be", "value": "A conical or flat-topped tip of waste discarded from a mine or similar site."}
{"id": "ec7f16a1-a45b-4dca-95c7-c86dcceaee50", "value": "A site used for the production of dyes from natural ingredients."}
{"id": "0e874bef-2bfe-4922-9e94-a6fe9d99a73c", "value": "A mill for beating and cleaning cloth, using soap or fullers earth."}

{"id": "d3942cc6-59f7-4c34-bdda-735983070c98", "value": "A subrectangular earthen enclosure defined by a ditch, usually with an internal bank, assumed to have been used for the primary exposure or burial of human remains in the Neolithic period prior to secondary burial elsewhere."}
{"id": "32c3ccf4-2553-42cd-aa4b-af325a340853", "value": "Artificial mound of earth, turf and/or stone, normally constructed to contain or conceal burials. Use specific type where known."}
{"id": "14e5de2b-19b1-4a29-9266-5712d6a1fd43", "value": "A circular bank surrounding an area where burials were placed."}
{"id": "b1096eae-4893-4c45-9aa0-b90bca593cca", "value": "A cluster of closely spaced barrows and related monuments (eg. ring ditches). Use with specific barrow-types where known."}

{"id": "de333359-77ed-4227-af8b-ec4e3c28ab0c", "value": "A rectangular or trapezoidal earthen mound of Neolithic date, usually accompanied by flanking or encircling ditches, and normally associated with human remains. Mound construction and associated features vary considerably in type and complexity."}
{"id": "e0dc1384-5827-48ed-942a-48df95b4a0f2", "value": "A stony mound containing or concealing deliberately deposited human remains. Use specific type where known."}

{"id": "cf325eae-cec8-435d-9091-53fa31104b48", "value": "A burial monument, usually of Iron age date, comprising a small square ditched enclosure surrounding a central interment, which may also have been covered by a mound."}

{"id": "416565c2-09c5-491d-a3d8-42080080e937", "value": "Hemispherical mound surrounded by a ditch (or occasionally two or more concentric ditches), often accompanied by an external (or occasionally internal) bank. Mound and ditch may sometimes be separated by a berm. Use specific type where known."}
{"id": "f842fd47-93cd-4d4d-937a-4579e7192678", "value": "A Neolithic burial monument comprising a stone-built chamber within an earthen mound. Use more precise term where known."}
{"id": "67c5b2ed-48fe-4e96-a21c-63cabafe96d9", "value": "An artificial elevation of earth or stones. Use more specific type where known."}
{"id": "2b54f954-cd6b-499f-8ffe-28c2b7bf0cfb", "value": "A site or establishment for the casting and refining of metallic copper."}
{"id": "a3e2d80f-c96c-4c7a-a269-ded66d854b06", "value": "A site where large sheets of thin metal are manufactured."}
{"id": "25343514-0a79-4cb7-a04e-f1330278420b", "value": "A site containing plant and machinery for the manufacture of steel."}
{"id": "18fb1330-ed1f-4568-8032-ea39efa985a4", "value": "A factory used for the production of red lead used in glass manufacture, or white lead used as the pigment in white paint."}
{"id": "9691a457-10a9-41d0-8c2f-52394c4dc42c", "value": "A brass manufacturing complex incorporating battery mill furnaces, hammers, etc."}
{"id": "0e72b240-1357-4c12-92a4-f62c70040b06", "value": "A site where iron is smelted or iron goods made."}
{"id": "47dd1ae7-ef51-41f2-878d-8aa0247b9072", "value": "A site used for the extraction of metallic zinc by a variety of processes."}
{"id": "0fea7654-1fb9-4ea6-8575-4ce886b92655", "value": "A complex of buildings and structures used for the processing and production of iron and tinplate objects"}
{"id": "8ec7bf50-b6fd-45d1-9b15-dd0e154ad202", "value": "A complex of buildings used for the processing of metals. Use more specific type where known."}

{"id": "6e8cdb04-8dc3-49c7-9d0b-8aab5e6bf58b", "value": "A factory or group of buildings used for the production of plated goods. Plating is the process whereby one metal object is coated with a thin layer of another metal."}
{"id": "197ab7c2-2824-463d-ac1d-49279d665b0b", "value": "A place where (young) holiday-makers and hikers can be put up cheaply for the night."}
{"id": "5403f0d6-c259-4b9c-a9a0-1efc054f13ae", "value": "A place provided for leisure-time activities of young people."}
{"id": "5f39ffc7-4f7b-40d7-8d52-9df28e24dd0d", "value": "A plant for bottling manufactured goods, as opposed to a BOTTLE WORKS where bottles were made."}
{"id": "3b8b543e-a146-4c18-b436-b4a8b57fdd55", "value": "A building or group of buildings used for the making, processing, storing and selling of milk and other dairy products."}

{"id": "d420f66e-cb64-407d-9c35-e5516b633207", "value": "Term used by the RAF to describe an open walled structure built of concrete, brick or sandbags which enclosed one or more machine-guns mounted on pintels for light anti-aircraft and ground defence."}
{"id": "d973fc20-b534-4be6-a818-bfb8c248fecc", "value": "Usually a small, two or three man trench, dug as an isolated fieldwork rather than as part of a defensive system. A WWI and WWII feature."}
{"id": "737643f7-8c55-4fbe-a48b-1685bcd22152", "value": "A school where specialist skills, relating to a particular subject, are taught. Use specific type where known."}
{"id": "bcd13eb8-84fe-4abe-88e6-b414053a74c8", "value": "A complex of buildings used for the manufacture of pottery."}
{"id": "39256e1f-d511-41af-ae3f-9a539569205d", "value": "A factory for processing rubber or manufacturing rubber goods, such as tyres."}

{"id": "46908f75-f6cc-431d-8fb8-b5398ccbf574", "value": "An area or defined space believed to have been used for trades and/or manufacturing activity. Only use when evidence for more specific site type is lacking."}
{"id": "2aab0c30-2aeb-460a-879b-9845cef34549", "value": "A site where cement is manufactured for the building industry."}
{"id": "3445a518-0509-4981-82e5-7e0aa1ceeab7", "value": "A factory which produces artificial imitations of mineral water, such as soda water."}
{"id": "3072525b-978d-4ae6-80e7-44ee383684e1", "value": "A factory where china products are manufactured"}

{"id": "9962d6c1-78b9-49fa-b757-3821df2b0d78", "value": "A hall built as part of a complex and used for the recreation of the workers or inhabitants. Usually associated with model estates, factories, flats etc."}
{"id": "a6a43161-a353-4ef6-9644-6c341a4345da", "value": "A building or buildings used for the production of paints, varnishes, colours and distemper. Use also for the manufacture of ink."}
{"id": "11379521-eb31-4540-8192-30176c1245ab", "value": "Chimney used on an industrial or commercial site."}
{"id": "19f77e6d-03fb-4df0-bfa7-833bfc561ea7", "value": "A factory used for the production of ice."}
{"id": "3e4a229d-f735-4fbd-9d87-43ec24e18780", "value": "A building or site used for the manufacture of weapons, ammunition and military supplies. Use more specific type where known."}
{"id": "a1bbbae2-7d53-4634-b2cd-dd551e5e476b", "value": "A factory for the manufacture of leather goods, such as shoes, saddles, etc. Use TANNERY for the manufacture of leather."}

{"id": "e04b8d8f-3b0b-4ea2-a099-4f158a1224f3", "value": "An area of land owned by a developer, whether a private entrepreneur or a public authority, and divided into plots for leasing or sale to manufacturing or commercial concerns which may share some common services."}
{"id": "ab52e672-7939-4544-8600-41dfa5cdbc9f", "value": "A factory for the manufacture of vehicles"}
{"id": "b751fcaf-d954-4612-8b72-aaf137725c3b", "value": "A building housing an engine. Use specific type where known."}
{"id": "329cccf8-7c07-4f86-be65-972ef413d757", "value": "A large factory or series of workshops for the manufacture of clothing."}
{"id": "8073748a-441e-4548-a1a1-c548d2ccc8e1", "value": "An engine in which the mechanical force of steam is made available as a motive power for driving machinery."}

{"id": "45ca0317-bcf2-46ed-ace7-6bb58b712d34", "value": "A building or complex, housing powered machinery and employing a large workforce for manufacturing purposes. Use specific monument type where known."}
{"id": "7826af28-5c6b-4eb0-8e99-11ce307f396e", "value": "A factory or site for the manufacture of food stuffs from raw ingredients."}
{"id": "91f466f2-c275-4404-8b1f-6ad81b460a78", "value": "The carriage house or garage for a fire engine - especially those built by insurance companies or industrial concerns."}
{"id": "57484246-e890-4269-abda-9e1a8195dce2", "value": "A self-service dining room, especially for workers/employees; also in institutions, such as schools, hospitals, etc."}
{"id": "887c5527-f997-4179-aed6-11261b4b61db", "value": "A factory or complex containing machinery for the manufacture of printed materials."}
{"id": "a7d0540a-7144-4b48-9bb3-2995e42c6a78", "value": "An office for the payment of wages, especially in industrial or commercial complexes."}
{"id": "b43ad416-8fa7-4072-a7f7-feed9cf9deb9", "value": "A factory or building where furniture is upholstered."}
{"id": "ef4776d8-34cc-41da-8d86-746cf8cd1eca", "value": "A factory where furniture is manufactured."}
{"id": "6856ca27-81e0-4ad8-9092-a98f7a44a6ef", "value": "A site where all the processes for the production of glass and objects made from glass are carried out."}
{"id": "28bcbd4a-573d-4b6a-8c3a-8f524f259509", "value": "An industrial complex involved in the production of chemicals."}
{"id": "d26de79e-fd8a-41b0-9116-01384b803a73", "value": "Buildings, sites and structures associated with the large-scale production, processing and preserving of food and drink."}
{"id": "cffe16e3-4282-427c-9334-589e4e1c4471", "value": "A room or building occupied by a person employed to keep accounts of workers' hours of labour."}
{"id": "175128c1-1835-4d90-bf53-e52f673c68fd", "value": "A purpose-built dwelling for the manager of a factory, works, textile mill, etc, often found within the complex itself."}
{"id": "33193c2a-c13e-4e25-8e88-9c0e763a6f36", "value": "A site where wrought iron or steel chains were manufactured."}
{"id": "e39db567-07b6-48f5-863a-89f9357270dd", "value": "Usually a complex of buildings for the processing of raw materials. Use specific type where known."}

{"id": "a1ba8b05-89e6-41ab-a2a9-70a2f39cbc13", "value": "A wall for growing fruit, dating in Britain from the mid-18th century, whose curving lines gave added strength, thus doing away with the need for buttressing."}
{"id": "70a1b274-836c-4515-9692-564c796a719f", "value": "A rough structure used as a temporary shelter for sheep in exposed areas"}

{"id": "e5e20ad6-5932-416b-bced-38c5412c8238", "value": "A building where patients or inmates of a hospital or workhouse were disinfected and their clothes washed or burnt to prevent the spread of infectious diseases or other ailments."}
{"id": "272968d1-60af-4ec4-a40e-8a642fa17790", "value": "An isolation hospital for infectious diseases and leprosy, sometimes known as a Pest House; commonly situated on the edge of a town."}
{"id": "b36e4d2b-8beb-4b06-b7e5-b004d978d759", "value": "A post to which ropes are attached to secure vessels at a landing place."}

{"id": "b1175ad3-4eb3-45f0-b0a8-a2cf92337b4f", "value": "An artificial paved bank or solid landing place built parallel to, or projecting out from, the shoreline to serve in the loading and unloading of vessels."}
{"id": "cd8ff5b5-8702-4240-b035-3c869accfdca", "value": "A large wooden structure built alongside the water's edge where ships may lie for unloading."}
{"id": "f7f5495d-e899-442f-8e36-47e73d6efe72", "value": "A large wooden structure built alongside the edge of a canal where narrow boats may lie for the loading and unloading of goods."}
{"id": "8070d6ee-1e35-4f24-9da8-cb78d3e3c077", "value": "A wooden, stone or iron post for securing things to or for preventing vehicular access to pedestrianized areas."}

{"id": "b95f60ab-aff3-4d05-9e2f-abe1633b94fc", "value": "An outbuilding containing brewing equipment, as opposed to a large commercial BREWERY. Often found in conjunction with public houses, country houses etc."}
{"id": "1b05cac5-c2ee-4e0f-b3e1-a0ae8aca3262", "value": "An establishment or works where the distilling of spirits is carried out."}
{"id": "b4806a33-df5b-48f7-8673-36c4e0cb5c1b", "value": "A building where timber was allowed to dry and harden, to render it fit for use as a working material"}
{"id": "c9445c77-07fd-4c15-93d9-c90917fba6d1", "value": "A barrel-making workshop or factory, found in conjunction with a number of industries."}
{"id": "dce82879-1534-4ed5-a9b0-6e9e5c3ab394", "value": "A site used for the manufacture of gunpowder."}
{"id": "e668a8fb-7454-4dc3-bcf3-43c32ca41363", "value": "A factory in which logs are converted to timber by running them through a series of saws."}
{"id": "1b701667-d2d1-4c16-8040-cd955cb7de94", "value": "A public house for the lodging and entertainment of travellers, etc."}
{"id": "02e86522-4df3-47c9-b8f1-bab7ef1cc38c", "value": "A hotel adjacent to a railway terminus. Railway hotels were often owned by a railway company."}
{"id": "3d4bd264-e1d5-4884-ac5f-e2a4880bddcd", "value": "A large, luxuriously appointed hotel."}
{"id": "9bcf4985-62c1-4e7b-b399-d85dc543ba56", "value": "A separate residence for guests, a house on a private estate or a monastery building specifically for receiving visitors."}
{"id": "efcdc637-dc0f-41e9-b225-46112ba145cb", "value": "A building offering accommodation to people who are visiting a town or locality renowned for its mineral springs."}
{"id": "a8fe3824-d0cf-4c55-8a62-b2bc887550f0", "value": "A long, low-rise building consisting of rows of attached individual suites of rooms used for overnight accommodation by motorists."}
{"id": "97c610fd-92b6-4b3f-8f9b-fe5abba2d5c5", "value": "A large building used for the accommodation of paying travellers and guests."}
{"id": "4b4c2c63-151e-4657-b899-d425f185002c", "value": "A hotel where no alcohol is available."}
{"id": "a9d81736-5f1c-436d-b097-5e45827fafbd", "value": "Establishments authorized to sell or allow the consumption of alcoholic liquors on their premises."}
{"id": "a6ccea66-4e3a-4503-846e-ccd983fb37fb", "value": "The remains of a vessel which has either sunk or suffered structural damage to the extent where it can no longer function."}

skos:Concept.skos:altLabel: {"id": "3cacacec-5d93-457c-bdae-3f0a68eeb94c", "value": "PRECEPTORY OF THE KNIGHTS OF ST LAZARUS"}
skos:Concept.skos:scopeNote: {"id": "35b427b3-4b65-4ea6-93bc-5db73cc8df14", "value": "A manor or estate owned and run by an order of knights and governed by a preceptor."}
{"id": "09968d61-d924-451b-8e40-fa0157cdf655", "value": "Houses specifically of nuns/canonesses or religious women."}

{"id": "ebf2238b-fdb2-4df6-a2a8-da2db1a2dba9", "value": "A gateway with one or more chambers over the entrance arch; the flanking towers housing stairs and additional rooms. Use with wider site type where known."}

{"id": "f1743fd2-5025-4c6a-9128-1c2cd3b69b85", "value": "Houses specifically for men and of chiefly mendicant religious orders. The status of priory is represented in several friaries. Use with PRIORY if required."}
{"id": "46116057-271e-41a2-bebb-0f496d9617d0", "value": "A religious house governed by an abbot or abbess. Use with narrow terms of MONASTERY or NUNNERY."}

{"id": "72ef7f14-7421-46b6-806d-f51bf1647b7b", "value": "The building attached to a cathedral or collegiate church where the dean, prebendaries or monks and canons met for the transaction of business."}
{"id": "cde93311-e922-4b91-a09c-821ad9174caf", "value": "A monastery governed by a prior or prioress. Use with narrow terms of DOUBLE HOUSE, FRIARY, MONASTERY or NUNNERY."}
{"id": "4b2162cc-72b8-4dec-854e-8eac427c2b4e", "value": "A building or room where food is prepared and cooked."}
{"id": "13640eed-d179-452e-b4d3-ca10807827f3", "value": "Houses specifically of monks, canons or religious men but not friars."}
{"id": "76e014da-4be7-4d0e-81f5-2ccd6c28f7f9", "value": "The principal church of a diocese in which the cathedra or bishop's throne is to be found."}
{"id": "6fb99775-3cbe-4cc6-a253-7dc228684397", "value": "A device used to trap or kill animals considered to be pests, eg. rats."}
{"id": "40ef9700-667a-4d7d-8f99-37cc685e193f", "value": "A platform or other structure for the use of a band of musicians."}
{"id": "0e45f747-2e0b-411d-9136-0bf908be5a54", "value": "A shelter in a public park."}
{"id": "729eafb1-ac5d-40d8-bf8c-f552032bbee9", "value": "A lake, often artifical, in a park or open space, used for the recreational rowing and sailing of boats."}
{"id": "6d97edef-2be8-4701-91f3-9445403e08a8", "value": "A park for the use of the public for entertainment and relaxation."}
{"id": "7142c0e2-2edc-4046-8817-8ec94530ddbb", "value": "A type of pavilion sometimes found in public parks or country house estates."}
{"id": "01591af5-2575-4f44-abcd-44eedef04f8e", "value": "A light, open structure for the sale of newspapers, tickets, etc."}
{"id": "cbb89517-3619-42fb-9735-9d3f9247b0cc", "value": "A gallery or building in a garden, usually south facing, used for the growing of oranges and other fruit."}
{"id": "ba2e31db-a2ad-41fe-8fdf-f7abf79b591d", "value": "Houses built in association with a factory, mill, railway, or any other industrial complex. Usually built by the employer."}

{"id": "10e82f53-c5ae-4dd1-9b5f-eaeae7d35ba4", "value": "A low, wide, circular ring or bank of stones surrounding an open, roughly circular area which is (or was initially) free of cairn material. The inner and outer faces of the bank may be kerbed."}
{"id": "c255e897-b885-4051-9a91-ddcd54bd5f18", "value": "A construction of wood or metal used to enclose an area of land, a building, etc."}
{"id": "030452f6-e6e5-4962-b0bb-da9a86183b75", "value": "A fence that indicates the limit of an area or a piece of land."}
{"id": "aab6195c-0657-4ed3-bf79-1f2ada92fe0d", "value": "A fence or barrier made of metal or wooden rails."}
{"id": "0c322f1e-831f-4ce8-8cc2-3ba848ca512e", "value": "The limit to an area as defined on a map or by a marker of some form, eg. BOUNDARY WALL. Use specific type where known."}
{"id": "abc80002-efc4-48a8-bf6a-56e45d4a9998", "value": "Includes any textile floor covering."}
{"id": "8f2d957f-b33d-4f89-9a42-f4c8cf660e18", "value": "A factory where carpets are manufactured."}
{"id": "fd0808a1-14a3-4fa0-90d7-9fcfbb187a68", "value": "An enclosure defined by an encircling wall."}

{"id": "6677ec41-48fe-4104-82c2-6bd4f073450e", "value": "A monument consisting of an area of land enclosed by a ditch, bank, wall, palisade or similar barrier, where the barrier consists of several straight or near straight sections."}

{"id": "fb31e6de-3dd8-4827-90ac-6efe98356d9a", "value": "A site used primarily for domestic purposes on at least a semi-permanent or seasonal basis, and which has been surrounded by a bank and ditch, palisade, or some other form of enclosure. Use more specific type where known."}
{"id": "ad2d4495-f749-448b-9260-6e572bcb4b6d", "value": "A defensive bank and ditch, circular or oval in plan, surrounding one or more buildings."}

{"id": "b9f0ea6f-7bcc-4026-82e9-7fbfa776706b", "value": "A monument consisting of a small (generally less than 100m diameter) subcircular enclosure with a narrow approach way consisting of parallel ditches (thus banjo shaped)."}
{"id": "692a995f-9776-43e8-8196-834c0d6c79b6", "value": "A pound for the accommodation of livestock."}
{"id": "5f479e74-24af-4595-8146-ad49e2544068", "value": "An area of land enclosed by a boundary ditch, bank, wall, palisade or other similar barrier. Use specific type where known."}
{"id": "971165d0-70ec-4148-b2e1-342e03ad12f8", "value": "An enclosure, often prehistoric, provided with multiivallate defences."}

{"id": "41f53e4f-4cc5-4097-aebe-548f80641a10", "value": "A circular bank in which trees have been planted for ornamental purposes or to create an enclosure. May exist purely as a bank which has been formed over the stumps of the trees which had been planted to form the enclosure."}
{"id": "49a36b82-2d03-4822-96a2-34451a28b4bd", "value": "A series of usually small enclosures which together make up a complex."}

{"id": "c9d1c72a-06e6-4fef-b35a-3221cb3b58f5", "value": "A Neolithic monument comprising an irregularly circular enclosing ditch, interrupted by frequent causeways, and often accompanied by an internal bank, also causewayed."}
{"id": "437ff214-fb7a-48b0-8453-6acecf0cc514", "value": "An area of land enclosed by a boundary ditch. Double index with a term to indicate the shape of the enclosure where known."}

{"id": "97666f38-b5e7-41c9-b173-8a97dce819a3", "value": "A monument consisting of an area of land enclosed by a ditch, bank, wall, palisade or similar barrier, where the boundary follows an irregular curving course."}
{"id": "7f01eb68-027d-439f-8544-0b541f13890f", "value": "An area of land, roughly shaped like a polygon and enclosed by a boundary ditch, bank, wall, palisade or similar barrier."}
{"id": "19ffd251-1ec9-472e-bd4f-36996525f527", "value": "A linear bank or mound of earth constructed by the action of humans."}
{"id": "05f58b0c-7cfa-4836-b41f-0255a8f3cbea", "value": "An area of land enclosed by a boundary bank."}

{"id": "40418e53-4715-4816-a9fe-5e21a403b01d", "value": "An enclosure where the boundary consists of a line of discrete pits, as opposed to a continuous ditch. Use with a term that describes the shape of the monument."}
{"id": "5d2d8186-b3d7-43e8-8757-5197e6cf0ac8", "value": "A farm building erected in the 18th and 19th century which were architect-designed rather than built in the local vernacular style."}
{"id": "307f6a28-1de6-4c02-a583-06f1dab6e851", "value": "A supply of water used to keep canals that were vulnerable to water shortage topped up."}
{"id": "98f15716-0882-46ae-b30b-089650040239", "value": "A furnace where metal is manufactured from ore."}
{"id": "b12e8a80-3725-47e3-a93e-c6e6c8d0fbc0", "value": "Buildings, sites and structures associated with the manufacture of products from metals."}
{"id": "d79c1291-3712-4f48-84dd-74edd0b97b26", "value": "Buildings, sites and structures associated with the metal industry."}
{"id": "ed9c7079-e596-4aac-91c2-cfc2ada81a00", "value": "Buildings, sites and structures associated with the processing of non ferrous metal ores."}
{"id": "9d374feb-9ef7-47c2-90d6-f8b841ea6098", "value": "A mill in which sets of rollers were used to roll metal to set thicknesses or shapes such as rails, beams or rods."}
{"id": "ca482066-5310-4547-84b4-8b20f20291d6", "value": "A factory where metal wire is manufactured."}

{"id": "82df0c78-a575-4929-8322-6154a032fcb9", "value": "A kiln in which the prolonged heating or roasting of materials to drive off water, volatiles and sulphur so that they may be reduced to a powder, was performed."}
{"id": "d99300d5-447a-4383-a1aa-ce6d3452ed61", "value": "Building or structure covering a casting floor or pit."}
{"id": "554d0382-bb2c-4609-8624-999b722d182f", "value": "A site where metal is worked. Use specific type where known."}
{"id": "47eb8d38-59ab-41d4-8fca-07bc1225967f", "value": "Buildings, sites and structures associated with the smelting of metals."}
{"id": "22385729-a7c2-493c-ab8c-ac622936be61", "value": "Buildings, sites and structures associated with the extraction of metal ores."}
{"id": "4385435a-6806-4aad-9f2c-e6a0f49163a8", "value": "A garden consisting primarily of rocks and rock plants."}
{"id": "dd3c9511-47c8-490d-a4a1-017308745ada", "value": "A garden which consists of rocks and rock-loving plants that require little water."}
{"id": "d3ad6254-20de-4b02-861d-2a6c883099ac", "value": "A pile of rough stones and soil used for the growing of ferns and other plants."}
{"id": "158aaf31-4e4b-448b-bfef-74a4027a3ea8", "value": "A fortress and dwelling, usually medieval in origin, and often consisting of a keep, curtain wall and towers etc."}
{"id": "9af5fce1-ae45-4c05-902f-7023bd7204e2", "value": "An artificial steep-sided earthen mound on, or in, which is set the principal tower of a castle."}
{"id": "6ea27f18-17c1-41cf-b2cf-9cd9a885881d", "value": "A permanently occupied position or building designed primarily for defence."}
{"id": "0a70e734-1fc4-4771-aded-fd4208a46b31", "value": "A fortress and dwelling, usually medieval in origin, and often consisting of a keep, curtain wall and towers made predominantly out of stone"}
{"id": "a4ebd32f-248c-4d2e-b154-bfc63b30e91a", "value": "An early form of castle consisting of a flat-top steep-sided earthen mound, supporting a wooden tower, and a bailey."}
{"id": "d73e7b84-bd7b-47a9-97c7-6348a62ef7d1", "value": "The major tower of a fortification, often acting as its last defence."}
{"id": "4945a824-6008-4791-a1b3-71a0d37a547d", "value": "A usually permanent defensive work. Use specific type where known."}
{"id": "31d78b72-cc61-445d-9666-10d56a8eae50", "value": "The courtyard of a castle, ie. the area enclosed by the rampart or curtain."}
{"id": "3fbe4951-5451-41de-af1d-6af84054d3c8", "value": "A house which bears signs of fortification. These often include crenellated battlements and narrow slit-like windows."}
{"id": "84099f9b-53dc-43ee-b88c-d32b65fdc4af", "value": "A special type of barn, lacking a threshing floor, usually with open walls, intended for the storage of hay only."}
{"id": "399325ea-5116-4ed7-8bb3-0e3131620f62", "value": "A shed in which cattle are housed overnight, normally tethered in stalls."}
{"id": "7b7f9a2d-eb3d-4c76-9771-33af5310d649", "value": "A building in which cattle are housed overnight."}
{"id": "af62ad7a-1d1a-4679-acf3-cabaa723644f", "value": "An open sided building known to have been used for sheltering cattle."}
{"id": "ea9358c6-1bf4-434c-a19a-43af8cf931a3", "value": "A barn accommodating livestock and crops, the former being in an aisle, outshut or at one end of the building."}
{"id": "c43ebea1-d9cd-414f-a40d-945c9a020b3b", "value": "A monastic cattle ranch with associated buildings, paddocks and pastures."}
{"id": "9de89f1b-2a81-4b71-b6e2-d1eb335e6c2d", "value": "An isolated cow house or shelter shed with a hayloft."}

{"id": "c4d27b00-7da8-4860-98a6-11b1ba7606d5", "value": "A site consisting of, usually two, sub-circular enclosures linked by a linear ditch running tangentially to the enclosure boundaries. Characteristic of the later prehistoric period in the Wessex region."}
{"id": "4e6c0c0d-52e9-4ac2-9b03-1ab315b846ad", "value": "A crane suspended from running rails in the roof of an engineering workshop or similar establishment."}
{"id": "0e13fc0a-e9ef-46bd-b987-8ef33709f79f", "value": "A hoist suspended from a girder within the roof of a building or workshop."}
{"id": "7a958f47-5d9e-4c07-a718-679cf58e1bf0", "value": "A building associated with the domestic production and storage of cider, especially on farms."}
{"id": "77c41f55-3d22-4c26-8473-0574302e8343", "value": "A press used to extract the juice from apples, which was then used to make cider."}
{"id": "77e98f8a-0937-408f-9281-e2cd183a5d73", "value": "A HORSE GIN used for domestic cider manufacture, especially on farms."}

{"id": "d8c68731-2e41-433b-9581-497f5161ea0e", "value": "A round or polygonal building containing a HORSE ENGINE. Commonly found on farms next to the threshing barn, where it is used to power the machinery."}
{"id": "644e2e79-f184-4e42-a4cb-34c7cb540367", "value": "A building or set of rooms, primarily of the 18th century, in which social gatherings and balls were held."}
{"id": "f56eae18-f523-4e6c-a7f2-9c907d330b42", "value": "A market building, pre-19th century, incorporating other function rooms, eg. theatres, courtrooms, schoolrooms."}
{"id": "04704064-e849-496c-9e3d-13baa1e1984c", "value": "A building where official archives are kept for public inspection."}

{"id": "e76bab4d-b44d-41a3-b2f0-0991b1fb116a", "value": "A building or group of buildings owned and operated by a governing body and often occupied by a government agency. Use specific type of building where known."}
{"id": "8b111698-6ef6-416b-acac-c709a4b75ed4", "value": "A place where people meet for entertainment, discussion or assembly. Use more specific type where known."}
{"id": "16f78cf7-8a95-4da8-9f66-541b9e907262", "value": "Buildings, sites and structures associated with the control, accommodation, service and testing of aircraft."}
{"id": "d41a7d93-59de-4f2e-8887-823384c049dd", "value": "A place of deposit for the storing of goods. May include a complex of structures."}
{"id": "b520d478-6b19-4f14-8fa4-d988be5f6c7e", "value": "Buildings, sites and structures associated with water transport."}
{"id": "aa101d89-7324-4710-8c8b-260c2e44ada3", "value": "This is the top term for the class. See TRANSPORT Class List for narrow terms."}
{"id": "754fa7a5-34ea-46d1-89c8-b2d660964cfb", "value": "A post or pillar set up alongside a road to mark the miles from or to a place."}
{"id": "001e7ad7-219b-4d39-8bd0-9684b9e464ae", "value": "A building in which horses are accommodated."}
{"id": "c6223d5e-d798-4ec9-bc29-024ed73da931", "value": "A path set out for the use of cyclists. It may be part of the road network, or laid in an open area such as a municipal park."}
{"id": "a77de83f-c283-473b-b08f-3097fa68311f", "value": "A tank used for storing oil."}
{"id": "da4ede71-8b43-4453-bdbe-f3d0b98d2cf8", "value": "A route known to have been used by pilgrims visiting a holy site"}
{"id": "c5c802d5-41b1-4864-aec8-5c0a77b5ee91", "value": "Buildings, sites and structures associated with railway transport."}
{"id": "faa8b771-a818-403c-b55e-3d26dddc370e", "value": "A route which is not necessarily marked by any visible features. Often with historical associations."}
{"id": "979d3e2e-5ed1-46b5-a8d3-f8a9cfaeae39", "value": "The entrance to a tunnel. Use more specific type where known."}
{"id": "6fe2f412-54ff-4be7-896c-3c495f2819d8", "value": "Buildings, sites and structures associated with road transport."}
{"id": "7dd069fd-17bf-48f6-9608-4d8c08cf0da4", "value": "Sites and structures used for the transportation of goods and people under roads and rivers, or through hills, etc."}
{"id": "2a38c147-7c91-40ad-bec6-205d32515ce9", "value": "A depot used for the unloading of coal."}

{"id": "9804312a-c158-4fe7-8ab5-c32fe13c1d0f", "value": "A structure of wood, stone, iron, brick or concrete, etc, with one or more intervals under it to span a river or other space. Use specific type where known."}
{"id": "0e4a035b-567e-4e22-894e-dcc03d11fd92", "value": "Pens for housing cattle awaiting transportation."}
{"id": "ffd600b2-71b1-4af9-b7c4-4ac18aa70238", "value": "A road or pathway raised above surrounding low, wet or uneven ground."}
{"id": "e1e4340f-be2e-4787-93ce-64c25fb10543", "value": "A bridge, usually resting on a series of arches, carrying roadways or railways over low-lying areas."}
{"id": "1298e328-3c75-4cf3-a6ed-f787aa8360dd", "value": "Sites and structures associated with pedestrian transport."}
{"id": "2f5b1cb3-7632-4066-9ef2-e4433d7638aa", "value": "A platform scale, flush with the road, for weighing vehicles, cattle, etc."}
{"id": "8db4b48f-51ca-4a6e-b90d-75493791beb1", "value": "Structures used for the lifting or hoisting of goods, machinery, vehicles, people and livestock."}
{"id": "95ea7301-44a4-436c-a079-3268be98a436", "value": "A building containing a weighing machine for weighing goods; sometimes found in markets, ports, etc."}
{"id": "48526d11-94d9-44df-86db-186f80e27429", "value": "A place where an aircraft has crashed and where wreckage may remain."}
{"id": "f6c71e8c-c922-45d1-a9d8-02859dbd34b8", "value": "A stone set up on a road or path to mark the miles from or to a place."}
{"id": "7e23cbec-b812-420f-a04b-9b529459f424", "value": "A prepared slope on which rails are laid to enable early tramroads and railways to negotiate a steep gradient."}
{"id": "196de8df-2353-4cb6-9c0c-432929d4e3cd", "value": "An area of land enclosed by two parallel ditches. Use with specific shaped enclosure where known."}
{"id": "3039ee54-8bed-4ddf-bd4f-f564b3c6dbc2", "value": "Industrial worker's house which has been purpose built by an employer, as opposed to the workshop houses used by artisans."}
{"id": "eceef4a6-da9f-4c18-a09f-8f5897c4104b", "value": "A one-roomed building in which unmarried labourers lodge together."}

{"id": "58cc3bda-be29-4aae-9b2c-a9e12ec0e37e", "value": "A building of basic construction, usually smaller in size than a house and constructed from a variety of materials such as mud, turf, branches, wood, brick, concrete or metal. Use more specific type where known."}
{"id": "66ba8e3b-fcdf-4715-ac9b-06d272c36ed3", "value": "Places of residence."}
{"id": "21392fef-69b5-40c4-aba5-a5f06dbd057e", "value": "The principal house of a manor or village."}

{"id": "15854ab9-bc77-430e-96e8-7a67a57e4c8b", "value": "A wide ditch surrounding a building, usually filled with water. Use for moated sites, not defensive moats. Use with relevant site type where known, eg. MANOR HOUSE, GARDEN, etc."}

{"id": "39e6cec5-260f-4de3-95a4-3de44209ade9", "value": "An enclosed piece of ground devoted to the cultivation of flowers, fruit or vegetables and/or recreational purposes. Use more specific type where known."}
{"id": "33d9e529-c353-4914-8964-0b79333c8231", "value": "A defensive gun battery positioned to face out to sea to fire on enemy ships and amphibious craft."}

skos:Concept.skos:altLabel: {"id": "eaa7be10-0524-4660-bb51-4118bcac481d", "value": "GORSAF DOD O HYD I GYFEIRIAD RADIO"}
skos:Concept.skos:scopeNote: {"id": "b4125c22-2c7e-4287-b45c-9d1f9ec51404", "value": "A building or site incorporating equipment used for detecting the presence of enemy aircraft or ships."}
{"id": "9b37860c-de70-4328-af63-02de17cbaaf0", "value": "A school established by the National Society which was founded in 1811 to promote the education of the poor."}
{"id": "f7f90cb0-29ef-41a9-a532-de798022c615", "value": "A school run by a christian church."}
{"id": "d7467aab-bf97-4efd-a67b-84eaa493819d", "value": "A building which houses the administrative functions of a local authority."}

{"id": "39d63e21-0403-4e1d-8dc3-eedcb94d1d08", "value": "A building from which the administration of a county is carried out by the County Council. It is also, historically, the site where the county quarter sessions and assizes were held."}
{"id": "56ef46f7-dd90-4e86-b16b-fd46dbbb0c19", "value": "House owned by the church, often used for meetings."}
{"id": "0f6f921c-162c-4fb8-ab31-7a61ff4aee50", "value": "A building or building complex where municipal offices and other public buildings are situated."}
{"id": "56596780-c31a-4763-aad5-a6018dfd3dea", "value": "Traditionally, the hall of a crafts, trade, or merchants' guild. Nowadays, often used to describe a TOWN HALL."}

{"id": "40ac864a-0d4a-42cb-b50f-d52289ae254d", "value": "A large building used for the transaction of the public business of a town, the holding of courts of justice, entertainments and other activities."}
{"id": "a1b74040-4e9a-434c-93cb-4726a81fd548", "value": "A quarry for the extraction of hone stones"}
{"id": "c2021381-415c-472f-8519-44627f0b0890", "value": "A building housing a winching mechanism"}
{"id": "7f71c81c-8ed2-47f5-9048-5db97a8df50a", "value": "A building housing an engine, usually with an attendant boiler house and chimney. Used for winding from a pit."}

{"id": "5059af13-3f8d-4de1-a920-d98d44d26eb6", "value": "An excavation made in the earth for the purpose of digging out metallic ores, coal, salt, or precious stones etc. Use specific type where known."}
{"id": "30d8fc44-a93a-4e13-979d-a131cf5466d4", "value": "A craft or repair workshop in a boat yard, harbour or naval dockyard."}
{"id": "77f38085-8668-4e88-8c74-cc391c043821", "value": "A place where boats are built and stored."}
{"id": "97eaefea-877e-4f1d-ae37-8697e777f475", "value": "Specialized engineering workshop particularly for the production of marine engines or other large components of ships."}
{"id": "ccd2f158-90de-49bb-8207-8e444c55e0c8", "value": "An enclosure in which ships are built and repaired, and all sorts of ships' stores are brought together."}
{"id": "effc99af-bb3f-4a24-a124-eea3bec0f57f", "value": "Excludes terms specific to MARINE CONSTRUCTION SITE."}

{"id": "243f848e-d7fb-4e79-aad6-f727b479bb4d", "value": "A stone-faced enclosure, with entrance closed by a floatable caisson or by gates, which can be pumped dry for inspection, maintenance, or repair of the hull or underwater fittings of a ship or ships."}

{"id": "0ce6315f-19ee-43e5-ad8e-6d4978098fe9", "value": "A structure comprising two upright spars, joined at the top to form a triangle, with a hoisting tackle suspended from the apex. Used by sailboats and dockyards for tasks such as lifting masts and other weights such as cargo."}
{"id": "4bd77e81-97d1-4713-b3a2-0e30a3866f0d", "value": "A place where boats or ships are built or repaired."}
{"id": "62297045-cfe1-4ae8-a0ac-a58e0c5b7271", "value": "Buildings, sites and structures associated with the construction and repair of ships and boats."}
{"id": "487e598e-e4dc-4e38-b81f-48cbbb91616e", "value": "A works where crude oil is distilled into its fractions or cuts."}
{"id": "41978a75-8c3d-4a63-a3b8-4fc62e4d3f99", "value": "Oven for roasting coal to drive off chemical constituents and reduce it to almost pure carbon, ie. coke."}
{"id": "6e00127b-a50e-4384-9b17-c137898f7b10", "value": "A site where tar is manufactured or combined with other substances to produce bitumen, for example."}
{"id": "8c933bb5-8a93-498b-a61f-ea0a433b0a1b", "value": "A storehouse for chaff (hay or straw used as cattle fodder)."}
{"id": "b55cd438-addc-4fd4-b179-2492e68758af", "value": "A building used to prepare and store dry food such as hay and straw for the feeding of cattle."}
{"id": "ede9b048-6033-433f-a0a7-78b903bb10c0", "value": "A building at a military installation used specifically for the processing of photographs and the storage of photographic equipment."}

{"id": "67b1d4b4-3ddc-4a8f-9e0b-446a0628d1bc", "value": "Orefabicated structure of tubular steel supporting rib framework clad in corrugated iron. A 'doppelganger' of the Nissen Hut, larger in size used for storage and large-capacity functions such as a cinema or lecture hall during WWII."}

{"id": "330d2058-7f12-4542-ac53-35f7f7862309", "value": "A prefabricated structure of a steel frame clad in corrugated iron. Semi-circular in section they were used as accommodation for the armed forces and, during WWII, as emergency housing for bombed out civilians. Also used for storage."}
{"id": "be31931d-dccf-42b0-b8bd-f80ec6fc2a0c", "value": "A building of unknown purpose found at a military site. Use more specific type where known."}
{"id": "7c43ee24-e6d5-459a-80e3-a51e580b6027", "value": "Ancilliary buildings and structures associated with a military base."}
{"id": "0a4b3e9a-c497-42f3-8741-ecaf2feded22", "value": "A building of varying designs intended for directing military aviation operations. Normally associated with military airfields."}

{"id": "a8d33b12-9c8d-4871-a656-e60c5756b47b", "value": "A metal, wooden or concrete box containing a telephone for use by the public, limited accommodation for use as a temporary cell, and a lamp on top that could be used to attract the attention of a passers patrol."}
{"id": "2acb1e44-125a-4ed3-9e4e-4f2e9de004fb", "value": "A roadside telephone box for use by motorists in need of assistance."}
{"id": "ce53f036-5819-4526-83e6-bfeaa9a0c4d5", "value": "A freestanding public call box, containing a telephone and usually operated by inserting coins."}
{"id": "44967f8a-a56b-43f9-85fd-1848fa8e70b7", "value": "A structure inclined towards the water on which a ship may be built or lowered into the water."}
{"id": "0ce233da-1484-486e-80a2-cc0b4a50c396", "value": "A wooden or metal structure covering a shipbuilding slip way."}
{"id": "cd51c1d3-db39-4d82-8ca0-3cca3aa1ccb6", "value": "A building designed to house a lifeboat, usually with a stone ramp to launch the boat into the sea."}
{"id": "d0d3f578-75eb-43d7-9780-040fd93d9e5f", "value": "The residence of an individual responsible for the operation of a particular length of waterway."}
{"id": "8bf621da-1ade-4774-a2e8-8b7c05fc9392", "value": "Structures erected on or near a public highway."}

{"id": "b1cf8645-3640-4d3e-a58a-886aa2831ab9", "value": "A light, sometimes ornamental structure in a garden, park or place of recreation, used for entertainment or shelter. Use specific type where known."}
{"id": "bddf636f-2781-42b9-a57c-9ea73c62ce88", "value": "A group of planted trees or shrubs, generally of uniform age and of a single species."}
{"id": "8b3406fa-b6cb-45bd-901a-3073a556c4b4", "value": "An artificial fall of water often taking the form of a water staircase."}
{"id": "96838cab-d4fd-42b0-8e2d-97eb4a8caca0", "value": "A flat, level area of ground within a garden. Often raised and accessed by steps."}
{"id": "0162e649-f120-4a1e-9c93-5c2afc818a1a", "value": "A plot of earth used for the raising of flowers and shrubs."}
{"id": "50a55412-7054-4213-bf2d-4374851ad10f", "value": "A structure or building, often within a secluded area of a garden, where people could go for quiet reflection."}
{"id": "c8d36d71-0c4b-459f-b247-4705a58439e5", "value": "A piece of land, sometimes man-made, completely surrounded by water."}

{"id": "1af8a8ee-c670-4015-b8e3-82dcaaa00aa5", "value": "A confusing and baffling network of winding and intercommunicating paths, often bordered by high hedges or walls. Some early examples are believed to have had ritual uses. Use more specific type where known."}
{"id": "97f1c69b-b4bc-4c1c-abc1-ff7f1b798c44", "value": "A row of balusters, usually made of stone, surmounted by a rail or coping."}
{"id": "b2f7d664-48ff-4aee-975b-f366c35f1ea7", "value": "Stone, brick or wooden steps or stairs found in a garden."}
{"id": "f72a29af-53ba-449a-8fcf-2a0003bad182", "value": "Area of land set aside and managed for the preservation of flora, fauna, their natural habitats and physical features."}
{"id": "5248ccfd-72de-41f9-ab38-0f32ed69ab92", "value": "A house, enclosure or large cage for the keeping and breeding of birds."}
{"id": "c3ac22e9-9b8e-4881-98c0-3eeebc3eb1bc", "value": "An area of cultivated, managed woodland producing wood which is used for a variety of purposes."}
{"id": "25c0ac76-002b-479d-9646-1c77209b6d76", "value": "A share or portion of land, allotted to a person, often used for growing, vegetables, fruit, etc."}
{"id": "b0a0fd3a-5844-44b0-b371-9e6368431a62", "value": "Unenclosed wasteland, forest and pasture used in common by the community."}
{"id": "13f5cb4b-3f7f-43b9-a709-2b5bf649d8e3", "value": "A garden bed which is artificially warmed by the presence of an underlying layer of manure or piping."}

{"id": "ba5a9338-6dbd-49a3-b1b7-e30038601131", "value": "A shady cavern built as a garden feature. In the 18th century it usually took the form of an artificial rocky cave or apartment decorated with stalactites and shells in a wild part of the grounds."}
{"id": "a97ebf32-6d74-4491-95d0-d633b3259328", "value": "A place or path for walking in a park or garden. Use more specific type where possible."}
{"id": "d2feeb06-6077-447b-b8b2-b8c2fec7973c", "value": "A decorative or ornamental structure purposefully situated in a garden. Includes sculptures, sundials, bird baths etc."}
{"id": "7e90af5d-a0a0-491b-ad6c-36c610ec12cb", "value": "A small body of water, either natural or artificial."}

{"id": "3b4b1201-c293-4842-9dd9-6fcc8416af6f", "value": "An artificial stretch of water, usually rectangular in shape, used decoratively, particularly in formal gardens, eg. Long Water, Hampton Court. Occasionally used to supply water to cascades."}
{"id": "b3a5b80d-9035-485e-84c9-9774173fa1ca", "value": "The boundary which encloses a park"}
{"id": "4ce8c41d-de3a-4c6f-a28d-74bb34ed338f", "value": "Unspecified landscape feature. Use more specific type where known."}

{"id": "7366eafa-fff6-4037-a4eb-71afe4aba6df", "value": "An enclosed piece of land, generally large in area, used for hunting, the cultivation of trees, for grazing sheep and cattle or visual enjoyment. Use more specific type where known."}
{"id": "0fa76470-2d94-4549-b38a-b419d1d08915", "value": "A road or way for riding on horseback within a park or estate."}
{"id": "f15f858e-30bc-4131-89fe-2537b8c8ff10", "value": "Timber or metal structure consisting of upright and cross members designed to support climbing plants."}
{"id": "cb8e5404-6588-47e8-ac9a-230d36a35c9d", "value": "An enclosed area of ground immediately surrounding a cathedral."}
{"id": "fb352051-d7fd-47e6-a1ac-31445650ecd9", "value": "A tree-lined way or approach where the trees have been cut into various forms and shapes."}
{"id": "9f2e4575-c195-4d19-a567-5558f23e52f9", "value": "A bridge built to enhance or compliment the surrounding landscape. Mainly found on estates or in parkland and usually 18th and 19th century."}
{"id": "8882e338-23e8-4def-848a-cabd1b5a3398", "value": "A plantation of shrubs."}
{"id": "16fd8507-e94b-499e-a74a-748ec191a4fc", "value": "A fall of water. Use for artificial waterfalls if naturalistic in form, otherwise use CASCADE."}
{"id": "2b9344a6-6d8c-4bd6-8cfc-a0f13683ce82", "value": "A large body of water surrounded by land."}
{"id": "b84a5120-c00d-4278-93b0-1b085c514896", "value": "A flat, and usually level area of mown and cultivated grass, attached to a house."}
{"id": "6c1ddc40-81fe-455b-95c4-56ade35210d3", "value": "A row of houses whose fa\u00e7ade in plan follows the concave arc of a circle or ellipse."}

{"id": "eff659c6-6582-4ba6-9dd9-580a938cab11", "value": "A monument consisting of parallel lines of banks, ditches, stones, timber posts or trees which appears to mark out an approach to another monument or monuments. Use specific type where known."}
{"id": "e2bdb760-742d-4cb1-86b7-2ac31f8b86ef", "value": "An artificial hill constructed in Tudor gardens, especially, to provide a good view."}
{"id": "df76bae9-313c-42c7-ab8c-cc7be663e0e1", "value": "Includes some structures that are not strictly buildings. Use a more specific term where possible."}
{"id": "0127f86f-b4b9-49bf-a1eb-b3efc4f48518", "value": "An earthen mound, usually within an ornamental garden, on which a tree was planted."}
{"id": "a3aa87b7-4b50-45f9-b59e-f1d216377133", "value": "A location used for observing a landscape or particular feature"}
{"id": "b5094764-7708-47e9-84d1-a43a33c6b9a9", "value": "A stone or brick wall enclosing a park."}
{"id": "ede5f068-277d-46e7-ae27-0418aed35da1", "value": "Trees planted in an ornamental circle. For earthwork surrounding trees use TREE ENCLOSURE RING."}
{"id": "27ced964-5fa8-4be0-aaf5-90568e5ae397", "value": "A dry ditch or sunken fence which divided the formal garden from the landscaped park without interrupting the view."}
{"id": "b8cf07a4-fe28-4302-8784-2b3219b1323a", "value": "A small gate swinging in a U or V-shaped enclosure, which allows only one person to pass through at a time."}
{"id": "93b79ba8-37dd-4211-bb58-f906ac5c712d", "value": "A tree which shows signs of deliberate management or is the focus for human activity."}
{"id": "f32f3171-b0a7-4822-9e4f-79389299b175", "value": "A wooden stake fence, often associated with deer hunting."}
{"id": "f7949ae7-5c35-48a8-9b46-6ea2885d6e84", "value": "An area of common grassland in a village used for grazing cattle, recreational purposes, etc."}
{"id": "5d240b5f-e359-473e-837a-ba60818c8e7b", "value": "This is the top term for the class. See GARDENS PARKS AND URBAN SPACES Class List for narrow terms."}
{"id": "08293343-b0b4-48ba-b9d6-e584c9e6556b", "value": "A garden or park, with ancilliary buildings, in which wild animals are kept and reared for public exhibition."}
{"id": "f4ebc71a-4b44-4f89-b2f1-2e876ec52ed0", "value": "Areas of open ground used for recreation in towns and cities."}
{"id": "6c726a05-0a5d-4092-a003-7c21561eef3d", "value": "A road/carriage way giving access from the main road to the house, stables."}
{"id": "feadc1f3-89f6-4562-a705-e39c364ebeae", "value": "A small artificial pond of water often found in parks and gardens, for decorative purposes."}
{"id": "6c24301b-3c18-4298-b341-caf4bcfa2c20", "value": "An uncovered area, surrounded or partially surrounded by buildings."}
skos:Concept.skos:altLabel: {"id": "0f90f5e1-fc03-45ba-9382-1112f443a91e", "value": "TIR AGORED AG ADEILADAU O\u2019I AMGYLCH OHONO"}

skos:Concept.skos:scopeNote: {"id": "0624dd15-1acb-42e7-95bc-8c0ec34b6edd", "value": "A wall in a flower or kitchen garden, containing conduits or pipes for heating the wall."}
{"id": "5a7608eb-224e-4411-bc2a-c7756779bd7d", "value": "Structures erected on or near a public highway."}

{"id": "d4ffd90a-024c-4fee-9cb5-fd426f45d2bb", "value": "A 20th century feature found in public parks and seaside resorts. The face of the clock is planted with low-growing flowers and plants, while the moving hands are covered with small foliage."}

{"id": "e11dbf2f-8d63-4af4-8bc7-c2bcf152795f", "value": "An artificial aperture from which water springs. The water supply usually came from a lake or reservoir higher up in order to ensure the necessary flow and pressure. More recently fountains have been powered by pumps."}
{"id": "f44c2bb6-2d85-483c-bbb3-1e6e19f788ad", "value": "A stone or brick wall either in, or enclosing, a garden."}
{"id": "90c65073-9fc2-4999-ae4e-dfd328763253", "value": "A site where clay is extracted from the surface of the ground."}
{"id": "17d3bd06-327d-4de8-a11a-40c11dfa5909", "value": "A place from which clay is extracted."}
{"id": "44af14c0-4fb4-40f5-b905-4e8bebc6fc8e", "value": "An artificial watercourse for the conveyance of water."}
{"id": "556de466-6485-4671-a55c-9c0f84e01aae", "value": "The area of water retained above a mill dam for driving a mill."}
{"id": "aa5e7ef9-8a47-4683-ad5f-a856be503090", "value": "Artificial water channel, usually leading to a mill."}
{"id": "c1f2f81e-f920-435b-adb7-f4416a50cf45", "value": "A dam constructed on the reaches of a canal or navigable river designed to retain the water and to regulate its flow."}
{"id": "5bd395ab-1add-4d41-bfa7-94304630e34a", "value": "The channel of water that provides a current of water to drive a millwheel."}

{"id": "7bcd1f53-2c87-4844-862c-f73402cf9c49", "value": "A stone or boulder which has been deliberately set upright in the ground. Use only for isolated stones. Otherwise use specific type where known."}
{"id": "40103d37-92a9-4add-abb8-3e3dc5430723", "value": "A single line, or two or more roughly parallel lines, of standing stones set at intervals along a common axis or series of axes."}
{"id": "4eaedaf3-2138-44ce-a05c-63e3a6a93b05", "value": "A monument consisting of parallel lines of standing stones, which appears to mark out an approach to another monument or monuments."}

{"id": "0fdae996-fbe8-4a0a-acd9-a3950e1ff3b1", "value": "An arrangement of one or more standing stones. Use particularly for isolated recumbent stones, or where original form of monument unclear. Use specific type where known."}
{"id": "47ef8880-fea7-4dc1-9ba4-6c73c9480b0b", "value": "The residence and sometimes workplace of industrial workers."}
{"id": "30598773-9d27-4186-89d1-d768fddcc995", "value": "The residence of a prison governor."}
{"id": "e0f4357b-08a2-4d6f-b2e0-44b012f9b420", "value": "The residences of people involved in transport work."}
{"id": "adabcd73-1727-47c4-9866-5f667cd679e3", "value": "The place where a house stood or had once stood, often adjoining a garth or croft."}
{"id": "72a74df3-37ee-4202-8b6f-50ecdf5b1299", "value": "A house consisting of a public hall with private living accommodation attached. Built from the medieval period onwards."}

{"id": "6d634e23-f333-419b-8640-2afedf3ee9bd", "value": "Circular structure, normally indicated by one or more rings of post holes and/or a circular gulley, and usually interpreted as being of domestic function."}
{"id": "35f91a52-ff9d-4166-a3e1-f121c8d1941b", "value": "A building for human habitation, especially a dwelling place. Use more specific type where known."}
{"id": "e3650dda-910e-47ff-b198-7aca0230dd97", "value": "A house joined to another to form one building."}
{"id": "3f77c8bb-1960-467f-882a-50ee7658b10d", "value": "The dwelling place of a farm worker."}
{"id": "d088dcc4-9d3b-4042-a9fa-68f1cad8de26", "value": "The main dwelling-house attached to a farm."}
{"id": "894f708a-8a7c-475c-99d0-b8514f30c285", "value": "A rustic building of picturesque design."}
{"id": "bded9612-4953-4493-b88e-de8e5fbb5006", "value": "A terrace house sharing a common wall with its neighbours."}
{"id": "49c05c6f-c1b7-4f4f-802a-b7964316d82c", "value": "Residences of religious people and members of the clergy."}
{"id": "43a03a90-8afb-4161-8a62-8318863a20ef", "value": "A dwelling attached to a CHAPEL."}
{"id": "081b0d8a-cc82-4b57-9f33-ce84b7cce034", "value": "A byre and dwelling under one roof, with a cross passage between them."}
{"id": "efeb9b68-e301-4737-bd8b-64444a4060d1", "value": "The residences of people associated with the sea."}
{"id": "9cfd19cd-debc-48c5-b4ae-641fa2d3351c", "value": "The rural residence of a country gentleman."}
{"id": "cf0916d4-d3aa-4008-babc-ba35fb258265", "value": "A cottage for workers on a country house estate."}
{"id": "41a8f3de-aad6-4369-950a-7ed54ef65c61", "value": "The residence of a coachman."}
{"id": "022c5acb-1e3e-4f10-aed0-0b05a19cd7aa", "value": "A house in a line of houses attached to and adjoining one another and planned and built as one unit."}
{"id": "cef3c807-f02d-4943-9cff-1dc40b1ca984", "value": "A gentry house in a town or city, either detached or in a terrace."}

{"id": "bde50f3c-40de-41da-8805-a4dd5f143419", "value": "An island, partly or wholly artificial, built up by dumping timber, earth and stones onto a lake or river bed. Often revetted with timber piles or palisade."}
{"id": "a460b7ab-05c1-496b-b6ba-8bd5f44e122f", "value": "A dwelling, usually small and rural. Use a more specific term where possible."}

{"id": "c3fb1593-6204-41a1-aaca-634f0ce9e8f7", "value": "A term for a type of house, with varying definitions according to period. Roman villas were high-status and usually associated with a rural estate, whereas Georgian and later period villas were often semi-detached, town houses."}
{"id": "fc2e2ffe-33a6-4342-a585-7faf5a6ac1d9", "value": "Use only for buildings which house motor vehicles. Includes garages for vehicle repair. For petrol sales use PETROL STATION."}
{"id": "df9c1b9d-4017-4f6a-b5aa-735a703a260a", "value": "A place where vehicles can be filled up with petrol, oil, water, etc."}
{"id": "483c0ca9-e477-4b02-ad2b-8bf833cc17e1", "value": "A building or room where motor vehicles are exhibited for sale."}
{"id": "cd8e3690-164f-4474-9e7a-e7732023c878", "value": "A parcel of land."}
{"id": "f13b0d27-9065-4aa1-95be-d9a6603335b5", "value": "A room or building in which riding tackle is stored."}

{"id": "7519fc10-e182-40b5-bfbd-028e8cead529", "value": "Traditionally a mew was a building housing hawks when they were moulting, however since the C16th the term has been used for a series of stables grouped around an open yard or alley, often with rooms above. Use only for stables otherwise use FALCONRY."}
{"id": "e9954a93-6ba8-4f62-9607-037ccaa1bac5", "value": "A place from where rescue missions are co-ordinated and casualties treated after an accident, offensive action or disaster."}
{"id": "46c6b834-cf2d-432a-9762-f12eadecab5a", "value": "A hospital building of uncertain function. Use more specific type if known."}
{"id": "8c72600e-ab99-4d76-b203-9bc09a2734a3", "value": "A building where ambulances are housed awaiting emergency calls."}
{"id": "f9c4052c-898b-49aa-ba19-9d357675dd68", "value": "A spa building to which water was pumped from springs or wells; usually also serving a social function as an ASSEMBLY ROOM, eg. as at Bath."}
{"id": "bd783727-e3e1-46ff-9d9a-b27bfce2aa24", "value": "A non residential building providing recreational, social and other facilities, especially for the elderly and those with special needs."}
{"id": "fdad633a-382e-4bb4-af60-038350dccacf", "value": "A room or office at a general practitioners' or veterinary practice, where patients or animals are seen and medicine dispensed."}
{"id": "98ddad41-a269-43f9-a8bb-d45ba2ddc77c", "value": "A place where either orphaned children or children from 'broken homes' are cared for."}
{"id": "954ab9c8-3eb5-4aa6-8309-b13202a190af", "value": "A house devoted to the shelter of the poor and endowed by a benefactor for this use."}
skos:Concept.skos:altLabel: {"id": "1ccbbc1c-471e-45d1-b024-ccd2c90d08a2", "value": "GWALLGOFDY I SEIRI RHYDDION HEN A METHIANNUS"}

skos:Concept.skos:scopeNote: {"id": "813d12f5-73d7-4bc1-982d-65ce8938a367", "value": "A building where clothes are washed."}
{"id": "00ca3018-425c-449d-903a-15354d7dd810", "value": "An institution, sometimes attached to a hospital, where patients may receive treatment or health checks."}
{"id": "e37a5ce6-e1bc-44af-aee5-3b2da521b648", "value": "A medicinal or mineral spring often with an associated building."}
{"id": "8f1327c5-1284-40f8-b541-45eab5e492e8", "value": "A light, ornamental building or structure built to incorporate, or in association with, a mineral spring."}
{"id": "8dddffe0-cb81-4ec8-baa8-4c1b88b26546", "value": "A building containing a number of areas for bathing."}
{"id": "2170d0c4-950e-44a8-9244-faebc391cd51", "value": "A building for the care of the sick, aged, infirm and poor. Use narrower monument type if possible."}

{"id": "9b861d80-8e78-4e82-9165-9460c908d982", "value": "A building used for the care of the sick. Only to be used where part of a complex, eg. a workhouse. In such cases use with appropriate monument type."}
{"id": "821dc26f-06dd-40bc-b55e-1b2fcc2d7430", "value": "A building equipped with facilities for bathing, and occasionally public baths."}
{"id": "c48e49ab-4283-4f88-aa3d-a6c390551cc8", "value": "An establishment providing care for the terminally ill."}
{"id": "6ce619b7-ea7b-462f-b1f2-3fa1bb7a9174", "value": "This is the top term for the class. See HEALTH AND WELFARE Class List for narrow terms."}
{"id": "bf8c3b00-9a73-4f34-a522-0992a29f264d", "value": "A building used for the treatment of victims of chemical, gas or other forms of contamination."}
{"id": "263dd686-b6da-490d-9770-3dec4e4f4d30", "value": "A toilet or toilets for public use."}
{"id": "68cb5685-8beb-46fe-97e9-19afa0c98df7", "value": "An establishment where patients can rest and recover after an operation or illness."}
{"id": "7053196e-771d-4a1c-8298-251db186499c", "value": "A building adjacent to a monastery where alms were distributed to the poor."}

skos:Concept.skos:altLabel: {"id": "49de161b-ef49-4604-a831-bb5165ddb5f0", "value": "BLOC WARD SALWCH MEDDWL YN Y WYRCWS"}
skos:Concept.skos:scopeNote: {"id": "c2fc5252-4fc6-40cf-889b-fca74484e14d", "value": "A 19th century establishment for the provision of work for the unemployed poor of a parish; later an institution administered by Guardians of the Poor, in which paupers are lodged and the able-bodied set to work."}
{"id": "cab65c43-45ca-4d1a-b360-cbcf29909fe1", "value": "A home for the elderly. Use for homes established since 1947 and state-funded. For earlier homes for the old, use ALMSHOUSE, COTTAGE HOME."}
{"id": "03611f02-9fa3-4381-9a5f-5108642ac733", "value": "A building containing rockets, lines and breeches buoys used to convey a line to a stricken ship"}
{"id": "0c2fac65-42cd-4812-9301-7b4dfd350636", "value": "A building used for meetings and worship by a religious community trying to propogate its faith in an area."}
{"id": "02b79ef7-f708-4b9b-bd5a-f01492e17d5a", "value": "A factory where short wool was spun into woollen yarn to produce cloth."}
{"id": "ec483fb0-4836-4c9f-8270-0bdcd16d7218", "value": "A large store where wool is stored."}

{"id": "e9d4872a-fc7a-4c39-aac1-56ed39f60071", "value": "A structure over an opening, formed of wedge-shaped blocks of brick or stone held together by mutual pressure and supported at the sides. A component; use for free-standing structure only."}
{"id": "d0547aab-7064-4b5c-b0f7-1f384f833196", "value": "A large free-standing arch erected to commemorate a triumph or victory."}
{"id": "68e92da7-84c3-4e35-9c3c-a952937fc13a", "value": "A workshop used for the manufacture of items of jewellery and/or timepieces from precious metals and precious or semi-precious stones."}
{"id": "06d792e6-45b6-48f0-b43f-58df3a4cddb1", "value": "A place where silverware is manufactured."}
{"id": "e39cb7d4-387d-4397-8152-33fe60beb4b9", "value": "A hairdressing establishment for men."}
{"id": "d507525c-ce1a-41e1-8b39-c618e149b9c5", "value": "A large shop supplying many kinds of goods from various departments."}
{"id": "9571fdb4-e8b4-46fe-a0cc-3637d405a929", "value": "A place where perfume is sold, as well as manufactured."}
{"id": "66016309-0006-493d-9d9b-535aebed81a7", "value": "A place where wigs, hair-pieces and hair extensions are made and sold."}
{"id": "270150c8-05b0-4eb0-a4e1-1b4533dfa933", "value": "A pedestrianized shopping street, or a more complex arrangement of shopping 'squares' and walkways."}
{"id": "8f3e1376-21c6-4e21-bbc5-6c7abdae0985", "value": "A place where goods are sold in bulk, rather than by retail."}
{"id": "403acac9-4168-4a9a-b50e-f3bb84dabfc8", "value": "A shop selling a variety of goods and merchandise."}
{"id": "0e1c6e17-635f-4efd-8be0-62eecdd72624", "value": "A shop selling clothes and services for repairing or making clothes."}

{"id": "cd19834e-14fa-440c-8d03-f4d7b7b8c41b", "value": "A shopping complex, usually indoors, comprised of a number of separate retail outlets surrounding an open space. Often on more than one level."}
{"id": "1310a299-9130-4b89-9c54-3c19151dbc28", "value": "A place, often including a BAKERY, where sweetmeats and pastries are sold."}
{"id": "81198cd5-e46a-4fa4-af66-241d5145a26a", "value": "Traditionally the premises of a chandler, a maker and seller of candles. Now, a shop for the retail of groceries and other provisions."}

{"id": "97254eb3-b3d1-4f6c-87a9-763c7c79228f", "value": "A shop which dispenses medicinal drugs and other health-related items. Can include an area for the preparation and manufacture of medicines and other drugs."}
{"id": "d1a83656-d114-451f-bfae-3733f16fbd1d", "value": "A house or building where goods are made or prepared and displayed for sale and sold. Use more specific type where known."}
{"id": "8071d8e4-d2e3-4e33-8b23-7f3e9ed77401", "value": "A shop associated with an industrial site run by the company"}
{"id": "0cb7e93b-7787-469a-8141-2b2063e1aa15", "value": "A shop where fish is sold."}
{"id": "8f4cb96e-c59d-4760-b768-4b3b3598baf8", "value": "A room used for the display of merchandise for sale."}
{"id": "77e7ef5e-cd7f-4fe4-bccb-f5e2bc3a6eb2", "value": "A shop which sells vegetables and fruit."}
