{"id": "4fd18145-42a0-40bb-a51c-fab3a82f4d5d", "value": "A channel used for or formed by the conveyance of water. Can be natural, eg. a river or artificial eg. an aqueduct. Use more specific type where known."}

{"id": "c34cf46b-bada-453b-bcec-f5251eaeb07b", "value": "A mill used for the production of mortar; a combination of sand, lime and water, used to make the joints between courses of bricks in buildings. In more recent times cement has replaced lime to create a quicker drying mortar."}
{"id": "dd394ba5-1a6e-42e0-8427-7cf2fa709b15", "value": "A type of WATERMILL, powered by retaining seawater at high tide and then releasing it at low tide via the water wheel."}
{"id": "24e61f1b-1df4-4dda-a842-9f452c7de0d1", "value": "A mill for the extraction of clover seed."}
{"id": "b9ea54cb-f3f6-4c2a-99b4-2469a550a262", "value": "A mill for the processing of chaff into animal feed."}
{"id": "6ed68797-f68a-4deb-922a-2c01e75b42a8", "value": "Any factory used for the manufacture of textiles."}
{"id": "d210aa60-b6ba-4214-ba23-46cdd6f2fedb", "value": "A factory where flour was produced for use in food products."}
{"id": "f1243fc1-6b67-416b-973d-e4916e793605", "value": "A mill where the machinery is connected to a churn for producing butter."}
{"id": "e6fb3b8c-163c-4844-8285-7fcc2b4520d8", "value": "A mill used for the processing of slate."}
{"id": "31c1af07-1744-4c49-a700-0e79283abc1e", "value": "A mill used for the processing of tin ore by crazing, stamping or smelting."}
{"id": "5686daf7-2c64-4c8c-85f4-e5e10aab5999", "value": "A mill for the processing of gorse into animal feed."}
{"id": "6a7d8cc0-a782-4788-a760-20876ab52ba6", "value": "A building containing mechanically powered ore crushers or rollers."}
{"id": "57abbe38-50b7-4c55-a2dc-a767783a2b18", "value": "A mill used to process raw timber."}
{"id": "50ccd0bb-f14b-47d2-af56-e6429afcf734", "value": "A mill for grinding or crushing bones, in the process of making bone china, for example."}
{"id": "2dbc2e93-dfde-4a01-97e6-81cb0535d06a", "value": "Machine, frequently horse powered, for mixing raw clay into brick earth."}
{"id": "d913aaf5-6c14-404e-80de-816b1b5c319b", "value": "A manufacturing complex incorporating furnaces, calciner and condenser flues. Use SMELTERY for more modern type of plant."}
{"id": "e43510d2-683b-4025-9071-697ced8faa6f", "value": "A steam-powered factory."}
{"id": "d81da368-3c86-42e5-b063-b256135ef821", "value": "A factory used for processing raw materials. Use more specific mill type where known. See also TEXTILE MILL, for more narrow terms."}
{"id": "0bd8baad-04c9-4dcb-b995-99dfc176472c", "value": "A factory where paper is made. Use with power type where known."}
{"id": "9b7215af-3c0e-4587-a2ef-b15ff120856c", "value": "The residence of a miller, often attached to a mill."}
{"id": "fcfeb3cd-9217-44d1-bc88-4916da380e5f", "value": "A water powered mill."}
{"id": "7f53932f-3ac4-4241-b5b5-86b547a6bb41", "value": "A site containing wind turbines used for the production of electricity."}
{"id": "38cfde59-09a4-460f-9fe2-5cc95f7dc18f", "value": "A tower used to store grain in."}
{"id": "099d203b-6a1c-4f5c-87df-aaa40b0d81c9", "value": "A storehouse for grain, especially after it has been threshed or husked."}
{"id": "5070a614-59b3-4d30-9667-6e547dacaac4", "value": "An intricately designed garden in which ground coves, low shrubs or coloured earths are arranged in interlacing patterns resembling knots."}
{"id": "e0cc703b-dd9f-4c8f-926d-231812e5ed60", "value": "An artificial lake, often made by damming a stream. A common feature of landscape parks."}
{"id": "9d6363b4-8f4b-45b3-b435-30bafab2ca9e", "value": "An indoor or outdoor market where leather and untreated animal hides are sold."}
{"id": "4f269986-5fa5-474c-9ac4-83e54cac0fb5", "value": "A burial site for animals."}
{"id": "d8ac2635-0c5d-4b4a-84e4-ac014071ae0b", "value": "A monument commemorating an animal."}

{"id": "7c5a85b6-e782-4886-8ad1-d6104d03825d", "value": "A tower in a semaphore communication system. Often a three-storey building on a hill in line-of-sight, signal towers provided working and living space, usually for two crewmen with their families."}

{"id": "8d935e1a-ea7f-4590-aa91-53a1e6879e35", "value": "A tall building, either round, square or polygonal in plan, used for a variety of purposes, including defence, as a landmark, for the hanging of bells, industrial functions, etc. Use more specific type where known."}

{"id": "337229f8-942e-4614-8b76-5d31b60d465c", "value": "A warehouse, usually under the charge of CUSTOM HOUSE officials, in which goods were stored before the duty had been paid. Often found in dockyards, harbours, etc."}
{"id": "f7b960ec-66eb-4414-b03b-96a948abf5d1", "value": "An office, particularly at a seaport, at which customs are collected."}

{"id": "cfad2e14-bece-433b-a1a9-0d68383aa802", "value": "A building designed specifically for handling tobacco. This may be a bonded warehouse containing facilities for removing tobacco leaves from the hogsheads in which they were imported, and pressing them."}
{"id": "887bbcae-dd88-4dfa-8bcb-66856610b54b", "value": "A type of warehouse, usually one-storeyed."}
{"id": "a829b055-c311-4f35-8713-2c212edae3f4", "value": "A boiler shaped like a haystack."}
{"id": "80a87bcc-5456-44a8-b3b2-f5ed256bbd23", "value": "The entire playing area and associated buildings upon which the game of cricket is played."}
{"id": "40f1d295-f4e9-46b6-abb7-8de7f192f968", "value": "A piece of ground on which horse races are run."}
{"id": "86280780-73c9-4760-a4bb-e06771d54191", "value": "A raised step, usually made of concrete, on which supporters stand to watch a game of football."}
{"id": "50bbded7-7887-43df-abd3-054375ed8b69", "value": "The principal stand at a sporting ground, eg. at a racecourse."}
{"id": "b95bf623-0dbf-401b-903b-1c00e1e88cc7", "value": "A site including a pitch, stands and other ancillary buildings associated with the game of football."}
{"id": "44b42987-eb10-4e79-9413-7e4e4d75cea0", "value": "A large, usually unroofed building with tiers of seats for spectators built in various shapes and enclosing a field used for sports events."}
{"id": "0c62bacc-4256-4acc-9af1-7de65b20bae1", "value": "A place where the game of skittles is played."}
{"id": "4ef27a93-b067-4119-9c0c-144553ba5782", "value": "Sites where minerals are extracted from the ground."}
{"id": "ac366101-7b4d-444a-9fae-449344b0fbda", "value": "A large tank where particles suspended in water, or other liquids, are allowed to sink to the bottom forming a sediment."}
{"id": "96539ac0-8ef1-4fb6-8562-d2a714feb3e0", "value": "A site where rough stone is processed, shaped, worked or formed into finished products."}
{"id": "1d51426b-af4a-4a53-ba96-3f36f5909dee", "value": "A building or site used for the manufacture, assembly and testing of weapons, explosives and associated military hardware."}
{"id": "1679f86c-44b3-4417-9cc0-1a60cfa54e59", "value": "Buildings, sites and structures associated with the generation and transmission of power."}
{"id": "c387d5fd-b6c9-478f-bd55-4e529c697e1c", "value": "A group of buildings or rooms equipped with apparatus for scientific experiments or other research, testing and investigations."}
{"id": "a5e6bf74-6dfd-4bd7-b41b-d3eb819f9164", "value": "Buildings, sites and structures associated with the engineering industry."}
{"id": "beba3207-ee87-4c14-bae2-3cf8c246741d", "value": "One of a pair of large circular stones used for grinding corn in a mill."}
{"id": "a4e07207-b80b-4c14-bb73-5bb9fd9a69cf", "value": "Pit used as part of an industrial pumping device, to accommodate the brammock rods."}
{"id": "362dbc53-4e6f-4d2f-978b-f0c001f132a3", "value": "Site of small scale industrial production often involving hand work and craft skills."}
{"id": "3d687b66-cf75-4fd7-b9de-4fbd53f1604a", "value": "Buildings, sites and structures associated with the disposal of domestic and industrial waste."}
{"id": "3c7558ce-c34f-46db-bd88-b84f5bc48271", "value": "Buildings and structures associated with the mining industry."}
{"id": "824cbe42-1403-4c0f-9d58-a3f1e6bda09d", "value": "A shed, often found at a quarry, in which rough stone is shaped or dressed."}

{"id": "ff115db1-6002-4e4e-b50d-37666dac6d17", "value": "Surface workings including shallow shafts, lode workings, open-pit methods and quarrying including some mines of stone, clays, compounds, etc. See also MINERAL EXTRACTION SITE."}
{"id": "efc92b68-4144-461b-acf9-8c6840bea74a", "value": "An ancillary building in a factory or other industrial complex where manufactured goods are packaged."}
{"id": "25eb9398-2cce-4781-9608-886f0d3e1c72", "value": "Sites for the manufacture of substances or items by controlled chemical reactions."}
{"id": "a8f74467-4976-4f10-820e-eb60c920cb44", "value": "Buildings and sites associated with the production of materials made from minerals."}
{"id": "831fa0b1-d6d4-4c3a-b2d5-54ea1212245e", "value": "A stone kiln in which seaweed was burnt. The calcined ashes were used in the manufacture of soap, glass and iodine."}
{"id": "f8bd9321-80b7-4f36-8af1-555188322196", "value": "Buildings and sites associated with the manufacture of clothing."}
{"id": "b8101d94-4d76-4c0d-a440-4afb6e0ddda9", "value": "The place where metallic ores were crushed and washed to remove waste, forming a concentrate which could be used in a smelter."}
{"id": "c0740cb5-5eb1-4600-940c-df29882f0666", "value": "Apparatus used for applying a mechanical force, or to perform a particular function. Use more specific type where known."}
{"id": "a2c35125-184d-41cf-a7e8-29a092ad9a68", "value": "This is the top term for the class. See INDUSTRIAL Class List for narrow terms."}

{"id": "ee78c8b0-8412-461c-b5de-1e150842dfc4", "value": "The anchoring point for cables supporting and/or tensioning a structure such as a radio aerial or other communications mast. Also use for anchorage points for industrial structures such as aerial ropeways."}
{"id": "3c58b7a0-63bf-48ef-a24e-8bc4800075a8", "value": "Structure supporting a lift or hoist operated by the weight of water in a tank"}
{"id": "764275dc-33fa-43be-bc26-cf856631e19e", "value": "An inclined ramp of earth, stone or brick used to deliver fuel to the firing hole of a kiln. Mediaeval and later."}
{"id": "4375bc04-ca71-43cb-bf39-af5d9c6d60cc", "value": "Any building designed or adapted to accommodate trades and manufacturing activity. Use more specific site where known."}
{"id": "a40e9e7b-078a-4fea-8f47-98e794d3d417", "value": "Buildings, sites and structures associated with the production and use of paper."}
{"id": "556da3d6-8337-4c58-b53f-fe50f15faf99", "value": "Includes all stages of production process of textiles, eg. wool, cotton, linen, etc, and textile products."}
{"id": "eebdc9ba-7c35-43d6-9df1-79753b000ad9", "value": "Buildings or sites used in the production of items derived from the parts of animals not used for consumption."}
{"id": "270ee5c8-0322-46a8-a3a2-d6c364cda937", "value": "A building used to aid in the drying of goods, for example, by means of flowing air."}
{"id": "b5f3233f-9be3-43b2-84ed-8b9ef7068868", "value": "Includes sites associated with extraction."}
{"id": "fc037685-aed0-4087-9a98-343b83329bff", "value": "A mining feature which is otherwise unidentifiable."}
{"id": "ca4a125e-0db7-4401-88d2-b7511ccabde3", "value": "Includes processing and manufacturing of all forms of wood."}
{"id": "95876a7c-eba8-48b5-94f7-03a90dfc80ab", "value": "A furnace or oven for burning, baking or drying. Use specific type where known."}
{"id": "fa428eeb-e209-46a0-a8d0-3efd7fa73278", "value": "A range used to practice the throwing of grenades."}
{"id": "8f418d76-9b45-4d54-9084-4b9c89eda92b", "value": "Buildings, sites and structures associated with the collection, distribution, sending and reception of mail."}
{"id": "eaa3e143-0ae9-4942-85b4-a8f02080efdf", "value": "A building housing electrical or electronic equipment used for communicating over long distances. Use specific type where known."}
{"id": "e619cabe-8659-436e-94df-d5a4efde1ea0", "value": "Buildings and structures associated with signal communication."}
{"id": "be09e882-9a2b-4d9c-8846-a529689cd79c", "value": "A semaphore signalling tower on a railway."}
{"id": "d81916f5-8314-41fc-b0e3-046a4bb99cc4", "value": "This is the top term for the class. See COMMUNICATIONS Class List for narrow terms."}
{"id": "e09b42a6-8e95-4d9f-8583-b5864b7f3165", "value": "A building or structure from which observation is kept of the approach of danger."}
{"id": "2f046e72-8a5c-4e5a-ab47-386804195343", "value": "Structures associated with telecommunications."}
{"id": "2989c6e5-b745-4f83-9eee-0681ff67cde1", "value": "An area of land showing signs of clearance for agriculture."}

{"id": "36918490-f604-4565-b530-07dc5a175e6c", "value": "A place or building where animals can be washed. Often in the form of a pool with a walled funnel-like structure enabling animals to be guided into the pool."}
{"id": "a69b9a6e-e02b-4c94-9c25-56d58d651cc6", "value": "A small outlying farm building used to store ash (which was used as a fertilizer)."}
{"id": "beb91d0e-deb3-4f8b-903b-5c6c2d30bb47", "value": "Areas of land used primarily for agriculture. See also GARDENS, PARKS AND URBAN SPACES."}
{"id": "215ce827-efe8-4dd1-972e-c544f6f85356", "value": "A platform for storing winter fodder."}
{"id": "f3dfa95b-317f-4b1f-80bf-740a447da613", "value": "A pen or enclosure used for containing sheep."}
{"id": "ef35cb05-ef30-4f3e-a768-700b76fc3cbe", "value": "A wooden or stone plinth for depositing milk churns on."}
{"id": "b95de056-6f74-4f00-8bf4-64236a43c6b5", "value": "A bank of earth located at the head of a series of ridge and furrow earthworks."}
{"id": "4f2c619a-cb77-4d9c-b6eb-1c9e72c15ea0", "value": "Manmade marks or earthworks which provide evidence for agricultural cultivation."}
{"id": "0385263a-90aa-4598-bb2c-24acebf22ecc", "value": "A narrow, open container, usually where food or water for animals is put."}

{"id": "321b1d0b-166e-4bbe-8651-c74b2dd7deb8", "value": "A defined area of common land for shared agricultural use within the boundaries of a settlement. Examples include Denbigh Green and Chirk Green. In an upland context use COMMON LAND and where the area is not used for agricultural purposes use VILLAGE GREEN."}
{"id": "2f5a4e2c-155c-444b-ab56-7a1c3ee71811", "value": "A small enclosure for cattle, sheep, swine, poultry, etc. Use more specific type where known."}
{"id": "964e5d16-3be8-4d68-8168-1e495f2ebc65", "value": "A pen used for the corralling of sheep"}
{"id": "d15bc59c-3cd0-442b-a8e0-c133c0f92ec0", "value": "An aperture in a field wall to allow the movement of sheep"}
{"id": "c7c80930-5d5a-464d-8dbd-2b40815147e1", "value": "A pillow-shaped, flat topped rectangular mound often surrounded by a shallow ditch used to farm rabbits."}
{"id": "31d85ad3-0789-4f6a-8ac8-7b32e83b290f", "value": "A wall built to give shelter to sheep."}
{"id": "24bfe8ec-1385-4e49-9f97-07690366ad69", "value": "An area of a barn, paved or boarded, on which corn was threshed by hand flailing. Use broader site type where known."}
{"id": "3395e416-f0c6-477a-b291-8022933f0797", "value": "Buildings, sites and structures associated with the farming of fish."}
{"id": "50e3f4ff-4555-406f-9192-c48ac1965a59", "value": "A recess in a wall, in which a bee skep/beehive is placed."}
{"id": "5217b9b3-109e-4b53-b2c0-e3c2c28f5209", "value": "A farmyard or enclosure containing regularly built stacks of hay, corn, peas etc."}
{"id": "0c4863df-7736-4aed-90bf-8acca42405d3", "value": "Pasture to which animals were driven for grazing, with associated temporary huts for domestic or agricultural use."}
{"id": "6244190b-1310-49c5-a141-43d7f852d9cf", "value": "A three-sided structure for the production and storage of silage."}
{"id": "6d736239-bc58-470a-9843-9864f06d808e", "value": "This is the top term for the class. See AGRICULTURE AND SUBSISTENCE Class List for narrow terms."}

{"id": "49bee041-7f4f-4b78-ae6d-75d4ed74377c", "value": "A series of buildings and landscape features which form the principal part of an extensive landed property, the core of which is a country house."}
{"id": "56ceb01d-7cad-4ef9-80df-fddbef2f32ae", "value": "An excavation from which stone for building and other functions, is obtained by cutting, blasting, etc."}
{"id": "ad3f22dd-0168-4c6f-8ff0-50e1c1e896ac", "value": "A yard or enclosure attached to a farmhouse, usually surrounded by other farm buildings."}
{"id": "5e64e2fa-2a69-499e-82c9-88a3b898e50d", "value": "A usually south-facing wall used for the cultivation of fruit plants."}
{"id": "99b2abaa-fc41-4ee3-b82e-8b65e9a334b4", "value": "A pen, often circular and stone-walled, for rounding up livestock."}
{"id": "030d933c-565a-4c9c-b96f-b79c1da2469a", "value": "A base upon which hay stacks are placed for drying."}
{"id": "83d7478a-36ae-4b34-ab09-40041d1cbb2f", "value": "The stand on which a BEEHIVE stands."}
{"id": "fbec7ed4-4c43-4bca-8169-aefad58dceae", "value": "A trough used to water stock."}
{"id": "b68ad0cc-e18d-4745-b965-f236974dc6d4", "value": "A pit from which marl, a mixture of clay and carbonate of lime, is excavated. Marl is used as a fertilizer."}
{"id": "1f4ffe35-5280-4a9e-bf48-4b70ee18658e", "value": "A local / Welsh term with various meanings. Often used to describe a FIELD BOUNDARY or HEAD DYKE."}
{"id": "a2d0516d-9237-413c-ba3e-f06317879eb5", "value": "Buildings, sites and structures associated with the hunting of animals."}
{"id": "d45feb89-1525-445b-90e1-0e7777a77935", "value": "An area used for the breeding and rearing of rabbits."}
{"id": "3e9d74cc-b908-44f3-a218-c16432a8d540", "value": "An area of flattened or compacted ground used for charcoal burning."}

{"id": "de79cd4a-2b37-47e7-959e-bf40d595128e", "value": "Source from which stone utilized for the manufacture of non-flint artefacts, including axes, was obtained. Applied only to sources exploited during the Neolithic and earlier Bronze Age. Do not use for flint mining or knapping sites."}

{"id": "b0999815-d5ee-473a-b0c3-e8a793ba41bb", "value": "A site which has produced evidence of in situ working of stone for the manufacture of tools, weapons or other objects. Such sites will usually, but not always, be of prehistoric date. Use object material where known."}
{"id": "833ca2fd-2a87-465b-b826-3f2b31e3cd6d", "value": "Place where a smith works iron. May be for small scale local use or within a larger industrial complex."}
{"id": "65c98d10-5dbb-4998-b44d-e8f1e28bae85", "value": "Obstacles placed in open spaces and alongside roads designed to prevent the successful landing of enemy airborne forces."}
{"id": "336e0190-e681-47dc-99f7-de5cf125da6f", "value": "A factory where tobacco pipes made of clay are manufactured."}
{"id": "aafa90fc-7529-4ec7-a0a2-cccaefbf0562", "value": "For the production of clay tobacco pipes."}
{"id": "753f4dd9-dbe7-432d-9f57-9e93d16d0da2", "value": "Use for free standing column."}
{"id": "ad54da57-34c4-449c-a911-7ea251cf091c", "value": "A piece of sculpture usually representing the head, shoulders and breast of a person."}

{"id": "2c84272a-4d8f-4220-8403-ab30e11c4554", "value": "A representation in the round of a living being, allegorical personage, eminent person or animal, etc, sculptured, moulded or cast in marble, metal, plaster, etc."}
{"id": "9c2ed7dd-b959-4c9b-a576-dc66826f6153", "value": "A mine excavated for the extraction of metal. Use more specific term where known."}
{"id": "2065140f-582d-448e-ae02-6f64d077206c", "value": "A structure in a garden used to house gardening implements, etc."}
{"id": "1dc0ff60-2278-4a9e-a037-3959bd83953e", "value": "A shed in which delicate plants are reared from seedlings for planting out later."}

{"id": "b7caa883-5dee-49ae-91f7-d19ef5c22f53", "value": "A garden incorporating features of traditional Japanese gardens - a pool, an island, stepping stones or a bridge, cherry trees and other shrubs and flowering plants grown with the emphasis on line."}
{"id": "546619eb-1363-438b-85ca-18f287c6160e", "value": "A kiln used for the slow burning of vegetable matter to produce potassium carbonate."}
{"id": "dfd089c1-40ef-4152-9fcd-4ac7f05180a9", "value": "A stone with a cross carved into the surface."}
{"id": "74309a9f-d1ec-42a5-86d0-886de3aa41de", "value": "A stone commemorating a person or event."}
{"id": "87c4afc9-0c12-48e2-a367-7f630a5f8ebe", "value": "A stone placed over or at the head or foot of a grave, or at the entrance of a tomb."}
{"id": "43c5f0b6-93a4-462f-aa1e-1fef6d169c00", "value": "Use only where stone is natural or where there is no indication of function."}
{"id": "6607f816-ad00-4930-b36c-514470351bf7", "value": "An early Medieval commemorative monument in the form of a stone which has been inscribed with symbols."}

{"id": "826f4479-1eb0-4db0-9194-2ff629c9363d", "value": "A free-standing structure, in the form of a cross (+), symbolizing the structure on which Jesus Christ was crucified and sacred to the Christian faith. Use specific type where known."}
{"id": "5fd035a6-0f78-4e3a-a67c-e01cad214dc7", "value": "A site where acts of corporal and capital punishment were carried out."}

{"id": "9b4438ee-66bd-49e0-9656-9f9b61b716bb", "value": "A room in which a judge sits to hear cases and undertake other official proceedings which are not of a sufficient importance to be brought into court."}
{"id": "7bc3a416-2ede-40f2-97f1-9b02dd9e0e00", "value": "The office or headquarters of a local police force, or of a police district."}

{"id": "c46b35c9-cdb1-4cff-aaed-58b6372180cd", "value": "A building housing the services of professionals with an expert knowledge of the law such as the offices of solicitors, barristers and lawyers."}
{"id": "47f85014-bd1b-466c-b0b9-1b9d5480b19a", "value": "An establishment where offenders are confined. Use more specific type where known."}
{"id": "d805393d-751c-4aa4-8250-b252a04d7bf3", "value": "Buildings, sites and structures associated with the enactment and enforcement of public law."}

Various mechanisms were used the most common being that the cars were attached to a cable and winding drum and were balanced so that one travelled up, as the other came down."}

{"id": "39520e43-5f22-4a12-8a93-e43ad2ea337c", "value": "A valve for controlling the flow of water along a pipe."}
{"id": "4b63d386-8145-4449-8028-26959e4d3faf", "value": "A building constructed to protect and house the workings of a sluice."}
{"id": "8b8ae38c-1dff-4db1-bab8-c92a83d52f35", "value": "A manmade barrier built across a river in order to increase the depth of water."}
{"id": "c9224964-1a09-4c9a-87ae-2b4b5950805d", "value": "A system of artificial or natural drains and ditches used to drain off surplus water."}
{"id": "9a70e343-3dad-425f-8b39-b53e8feeb62f", "value": "A large wooden gate, positioned at either end of a canal or river lock, equipped with sluices to let water through."}

{"id": "95c7c54a-bd8e-4b1a-84b0-27530f4c99c9", "value": "A section of the water channel on a canal or river shut off above and below by lock gates provided with sluices to let the water out and in, and thus raise or lower boats from one level to another. Use more specific type where known."}

{"id": "80be34b6-72da-4d81-900c-bb12119f8dae", "value": "An iron, stone or concrete tower built up from the bed of a reservoir. From it the control valves of the pipes which draw off water at different levels are operated."}
{"id": "40c4c03c-505e-4de2-bad2-9ce57f50e90e", "value": "A dam which can be raised or lowered to regulate the flow of water."}

{"id": "4e959227-ed52-4055-8f5c-acc0aa9ee832", "value": "Manmade constructions used to prevent water flooding the surrounding area. Often taking the form of a bank or wall but may be more elaborate e.g. the Thames Barrier."}
{"id": "ee39cbae-ffd0-4ae4-98e7-6fca6af03cec", "value": "A feature located, and associated with, an aqueduct. Includes features which form parts of buried sections of aqueducts."}
{"id": "1cffba0d-c9e8-44d8-82a9-449ea77efeb2", "value": "The gate of a sluice which can be opened or shut to let out or retain the water."}
{"id": "9aa957b2-246b-4608-9682-50e619c85936", "value": "A wall structure built to direct a current into the desired channel in a harbour, river etc."}
{"id": "cb766157-6930-42ae-8c4b-bb24cbc3d4ea", "value": "A small building housing a valve which controls the flow of water from a reservoir via a canal feeder channel to a canal."}

{"id": "b6f5d1b9-1dfd-4c4d-a8b6-0b698f5c52a5", "value": "A cairn featuring a mound of small diameter (normally less than 6m), which is surrounded by a kerb of stones which are considerably taller than the mound."}
{"id": "099895f2-1f54-4e71-92f7-fd84c6a3c698", "value": "A free school for poor children."}
{"id": "d17b59d9-dad5-4454-8098-472df01662ef", "value": "A public house offering lodgings to the passengers, and stabling for the horses of stage coaches."}
{"id": "8491c4a6-bb48-4276-a81b-98e4db4f71cd", "value": "A wayside inn for livestock traders."}
{"id": "18bd4dd9-f8db-4a86-be82-7a3f658b8dde", "value": "An outbuilding where a horse-drawn carriage is kept."}
{"id": "b0e7cd53-72f2-45e1-ae58-7069628d08df", "value": "A building, similar to a cart shed, but used to house traps, gigs and coaches."}
{"id": "512e350d-50d8-48f4-a354-43686d190ba0", "value": "An outbuilding used for the storage and maintenance of horse-drawn carriages."}
{"id": "554fa9cb-a843-4383-a9e8-9ff3cdd445d7", "value": "An area of the floor, wall or ceiling of a building, which has been painted, carved, sculpted or decorated."}
{"id": "afcba237-3d6a-4971-aebc-2442cc778793", "value": "An identified and often named part of the sea."}
{"id": "b48df6eb-3377-4615-8e98-d834b1dfdab5", "value": "Use more specific term where known"}
{"id": "504e8d2f-9ab0-46e1-9413-4b2414eb8c9f", "value": "A complex of building. Use more specific term where known."}
{"id": "14c2bbc8-20bd-4b99-af85-bc26613039cd", "value": "A trench in which a cable is laid."}
{"id": "43dd405f-9af4-4e11-b500-fafd082cd1b6", "value": "Container for the storage of unspecified materials."}
{"id": "91453eb1-71e3-4496-8b0c-aabadeaf3e19", "value": "An ill-defined pile of stones. Use more specific term where known."}
{"id": "b7391764-f87e-4a54-9e44-0810635d76b0", "value": "A stone (including standing stones, natural boulders and rock outcrops) decorated with carved motifs."}
{"id": "94927f4d-537f-4c43-bad0-6e44514d4d57", "value": "A brick, stone or iron receptacle for baking bread or other food in."}
{"id": "d37b6817-916a-4c2f-969b-b7b86c7bb44a", "value": "A large stone used by cattle to rub up against and so scratch themselves."}
{"id": "22af1408-a60f-40a3-b09c-1652c6068ba5", "value": "A building or structure for the storage of processed minerals, chemicals or agricultural products, etc. Use more specific type where known."}
{"id": "afd0463c-c9ec-4767-bfb9-2436e72245a1", "value": "A path or road for pedestrians, laid or beaten in with stones or other materials."}
{"id": "2fa9357c-f154-4f0c-a3f3-51843e8738f2", "value": "A piece of stone, usually shaped, of uncertain origin or use."}
{"id": "943e7ee3-6200-4ecd-af55-f5fe28d04f8e", "value": "A conical textile tube attached to a freestanding staff designed to indicate wind direction and relative wind speed."}
{"id": "e1f43013-ca6a-4c99-a2a9-469234901f87", "value": "A place where a number of objects have been discovered, either as the result of loss or deliberate deposit."}
{"id": "e944d172-aa7c-45b3-99c1-32606b11c423", "value": "A conduit or pipes, used primarily for conveying petroleum from oil wells to a refinery, or for supplying water to a town or district, etc."}
{"id": "9c7ddb5d-c3da-48eb-9852-d6096bc6021d", "value": "An edging of stone forming the kerb of a path."}
{"id": "1af4c5e0-4207-4a6d-9c4f-a26e72c52773", "value": "An artificially raised level of ground."}
{"id": "3d0a1ad0-1435-40a0-bafd-5c33c2544239", "value": "An extensive area of land which demonstrates manipulation by human endeavour."}

{"id": "8d558b7b-af91-4f3c-b158-4e7608d56360", "value": "This is the top term for the class. This class includes terms with very broad definitions which could be assigned to three or more classes. See UNASSIGNED Class List for narrow terms."}
{"id": "27f6f2ff-9292-42c0-8f7a-11d2ba07ef16", "value": "An external structure used to sit on."}
{"id": "8ec5105b-0ed4-452e-b71b-d5cb07367358", "value": "The court or enclosed space at the front of a building."}
{"id": "f9593983-af89-4b9e-bd6d-7e5adb954741", "value": "The post to which a gate is attached. If built of coursed stone use GATE PIER."}
{"id": "3c0fac4b-112b-4372-9b8c-f1b1421cfb34", "value": "An ill-defined spread of stones. Use more specific term where known."}
{"id": "cbbaf0e5-5b60-4028-add0-8327002dd212", "value": "An ornamented feature. Use more specific term where known."}
{"id": "a9a1f6da-12e7-46b1-a6ef-4693c89d1685", "value": "A depression in the ground caused by the explosion of a mine or bombshell."}
{"id": "3a945ddd-4355-476e-9dfd-2dd0da042c26", "value": "The name of a locality which suggests the presence of an unrecognized historical or archaeological site"}
{"id": "2e299504-817a-44a5-97d5-578af07404e5", "value": "The opening in a boundary feature to allow access."}
{"id": "2326253e-bd2f-48b1-89fb-d905d821a87c", "value": "A dwelling, located at the entrance, or gates, to an estate, park, schools, or factory."}
{"id": "56ec422f-33cc-4aa0-a17d-ecba17139916", "value": "An area of land which has been drained or cleared for habitation and/or cultivation."}
{"id": "1df40f5a-6814-4b6a-9534-2a5f2649d4f0", "value": "A hollow, concave formation or place, which has sometimes been dug out."}
{"id": "2fe65fd9-6695-4c7d-bcd7-f39733a21373", "value": "Use only if function unknown, otherwise use specific type."}

skos:Concept.skos:prefLabel: {"id": "7b0fe495-be91-4603-b5b6-54555debea0d", "value": "HEB FOD YN PERTHYN I\u2019R HEN FYD"}
skos:Concept.skos:scopeNote: {"id": "defb67a3-c338-4dae-9d80-8f9d61edf3d9", "value": "Use to identify a feature, previously thought to be a monument but now disproved, or to avoid erroneous identification as a monument in future. Where a feature is regarded as an antiquity, but is unclassified, use SITE."}
{"id": "f17be76c-6e37-4708-822c-2932056cba5c", "value": "Use more specific term where known."}
{"id": "a6d4dd35-5172-4840-8c2b-e75a6d5fb992", "value": "Horizontal tunnel opening from the surface used for haulage or access to a mine. In Wales it is a term usually applied to a drainage level."}
{"id": "75afa28f-4948-4b08-9115-e31752b99094", "value": "A permanent location where games and rides (such as roller coasters) are used for entertainment."}
{"id": "427e4070-d1eb-41d3-968d-668ffd3563f3", "value": "A garden building on an estate used by fishing parties."}
{"id": "a7c2a077-1c94-45df-8b39-4b4ab61c8dfb", "value": "Buildings and structures associated with good health and recreation."}
{"id": "20bd5eb6-5211-4f17-a1cf-e31d4519408c", "value": "A pavilion at the end of a PLEASURE PIER."}
{"id": "049373e4-5abb-4d49-806b-438c62a34cb8", "value": "A site where the baiting of animals took place. Use more specific site type where known."}
{"id": "04a625dc-6fe0-4b0d-96d5-b612c02e9f64", "value": "A place with organized amusements for people on holiday."}
{"id": "9b4fd252-074f-460c-8df9-160924beeadc", "value": "A shelter, sometimes camouflaged, for the observation of birds and animals at close quarters."}
{"id": "9c5a9c96-bf36-4164-bae7-28d7c69e8182", "value": "An area where fish are naturally present, eg. part of a river."}
{"id": "493990f4-e007-4e88-8173-655eda5909dc", "value": "Including accommodation for animals, birds, reptiles and fish in captivity."}
{"id": "c4653654-66a4-4382-9777-7bd16bbb694a", "value": "A light, ornamental building or structure situated close to the sea."}
{"id": "ccd947b5-ab4a-47e6-99e8-1d98a05cb404", "value": "An area of land used for camping and/or caravanning. Usually provided with basic amenities."}
{"id": "3ed45f50-6488-4a83-a18d-21d1538d59f0", "value": "An area identified for use picnics, often provided with picnic tables and rubbish bins."}
{"id": "d99b97a7-24bf-453e-a6cf-b87ab20945df", "value": "A small-scale railway, often for the transportation of children at a place of recreation."}
{"id": "e19f87b6-07d0-4649-bb8e-10649f17f7bd", "value": "Buildings and structures associated with educational and artistic recreational activities."}
{"id": "afe4453c-ad17-4a08-9cc5-d86cd9bc707b", "value": "A seaside pier used as a promenade and amusement park."}
{"id": "185891c8-faad-45b4-9ec6-5e8a29d6529a", "value": "Buildings where gambling takes place."}
{"id": "8b9c0c7c-8911-4c60-b12b-e47ea1daf454", "value": "A building used by an association of persons for social and recreational purposes or for the promotion of some common object."}
{"id": "34df35bb-6bdb-4978-ba2c-7f6ca87f2a82", "value": "A building occupied by a club or commonly used for club activities."}
{"id": "b93d2eda-2d0d-41c5-aaba-0eae1f5243e8", "value": "An area of land on which an eisteddfod has been held."}
{"id": "f0626492-823c-46af-bc6a-497d5f9a23aa", "value": "A site available to the public for the pursuit of leisure and recreational activities."}
{"id": "b3fc9f60-edb2-4e7d-b135-1f54bdad5f23", "value": "Buildings, sites and structures associated with sporting activities."}

{"id": "d2cd7b09-6ba5-480a-a5f3-7908da81f568", "value": "An oval or circular building with seats rising in tiers around a central open space. Used for religious ceremonies, entertainment, training and armed combat contests."}
{"id": "e2ebc285-ecd8-40f2-b4c6-0c21a8bc6ad3", "value": "A building where people pay to see films and 'moving pictures'."}
{"id": "82ec32ef-89cb-4905-80bf-f9cf6cf72063", "value": "Buildings and structures associated with the performance of musical, oratory and dance events."}
{"id": "5823a86e-303d-402b-9294-91406d8d484d", "value": "A site used for the temporary or permanent parking of caravans for recreational use."}
{"id": "ab48b3cb-81cb-45c2-a4d4-e546f0b8ad2a", "value": "This is the top term for the class. See RECREATIONAL Class List for narrow terms."}
{"id": "2a07ad76-ac3a-4b43-995e-484cb8cd1791", "value": "A site where merchandise and goods are temporarily stored before or after transportation by rail."}

{"id": "9992c80e-9b01-4ea5-a54f-de6e5d1e4ae3", "value": "A series of parallel railway sidings on which goods wagons originating from different locations can be sorted or re-sorted into new trains before being despatched to their next destination or sorting points."}
{"id": "3cfb6f8d-5e40-4f91-96fe-ef9d4f0c5e29", "value": "A railway station or platform built specifically for the loading and unloading of goods."}

{"id": "96da2aa1-fc16-417c-b938-0a86deda0d40", "value": "A large building, situated at a railway terminus, used for the temporary storage of goods or merchandise awaiting transportation to or from a railway."}
{"id": "413b0952-4b06-4e00-8d92-93ad4d7089c3", "value": "A building in which railway wagons can unload local goods."}
{"id": "4309debf-7a0b-4b30-950b-1f9842c94839", "value": "A building for sheltering sheep."}
{"id": "f41c0056-e786-4e48-b99b-272a4f9ef001", "value": "Living quarters for animals, birds, etc, as pets or for observation, entertainment, etc."}
{"id": "e4a87f94-e895-4b3d-9dd1-ada2a5361605", "value": "A building in which animals are housed. For non agricultural use see ANIMAL HOUSE and narrow terms in RECREATIONAL class."}
{"id": "48b93e7f-31b5-45b3-94a2-3edb9de12347", "value": "A building in which oxen are accommodated."}
{"id": "b4eefed7-a964-43a8-833a-5d432c8dd1e0", "value": "An open-sided building known to have been used for sheltering animals other than cattle."}
{"id": "233fdc23-c8f9-489b-b9a6-4c27a485e86f", "value": "An artificial navigable waterway used for the transportation of goods. Nowadays also used for recreational purposes."}
{"id": "9a7a246e-d69c-41a5-8c86-12a9467440a1", "value": "The residence of a lock-keeper."}
{"id": "b1b21cc1-f946-4843-b0e7-303b329e6c62", "value": "A giant figure of a man or animal carved on a hillside."}
{"id": "cfc8348d-29b7-462e-b6e9-dd40ed21a224", "value": "A site used for the production and/or working of metallic iron."}

{"id": "0fc36a50-508f-44b6-9150-b9812bd9f778", "value": "An often squat building with thick, loopholed walls and a flat roof, designed to accommodate a variety of weapons, usually strategically positioned to cover a vulnerable point in a defensive system."}

{"id": "be3322d0-a6e2-43b8-bcca-696ea186b4f2", "value": "Blocks of solid concrete, in the form of cylinders usually 2 feet across x 2 feet 6 inches or 3 feet high. Cylinders were mainly used in road blocks intended to impede enemy movement in the event of invasion."}
{"id": "8e334acf-f5de-4942-9626-e0f4a02a5dbd", "value": "A wall, usually of reinforced concrete, designed to obstruct the progress of a tank or armoured vehicle."}
{"id": "2b4823cc-fb31-42c0-a4fb-a788a0d9cee3", "value": "An area of ground or water containing explosive mines."}
{"id": "a9dcd9f5-d7a9-46a3-b2cc-237b8aba22ff", "value": "Reinforced concrete blocks, walls or ditches designed to obstruct the progress of a tank or armoured vehicle."}
{"id": "90226181-0dc7-4047-9337-431eccaf1c33", "value": "A road block formed by placing rails or girders in an upright position in sockets in the road surface, forming a moveable barrier."}
{"id": "dd076e40-3d8d-4afe-a0a8-8d667790bc60", "value": "An anti tank wall constructed specifically to be used for training purposes."}
{"id": "fda4aff5-ed7a-4afe-8d1b-7c53a49d7ad1", "value": "A ditch designed to obstruct the progress of a tank or armoured vehicle. Use more specific type where known."}

{"id": "134fea27-a39c-4f4b-99e7-2c373ac115cf", "value": "Cubes of solid concrete, usually with sides of 3 feet 6 inches or 5 feet which when placed in rows were intended to form a substantial barrier to enemy armoured divisions in the event of invasion."}

{"id": "00fc7ed6-028f-4028-b034-03b64eca741d", "value": "A building with a range of facilities for the exclusive use of its all-male membership. Rooms were often provided as offices or short term accommodation, and the club could be used for business or social gatherings."}

{"id": "f3923bfc-4fdf-4714-b085-848089f0d297", "value": "A structure, often found in 18th century landscape gardens, that demonstrates eccentricity or excess rather than practical purpose. They can take many forms - ruins, sham castles, towers, hermits' cells or grottoes."}

{"id": "7d1ad315-8c35-4404-850c-a72df668879a", "value": "A system of communication that includes a number of elements, including the line or track, signalling systems and associated structures for the carraige of passengers or goods. Movement is usually enabled by the use of a locomotive engine."}
{"id": "08184b18-86d9-4b7c-9908-9d933c40582c", "value": "An unspecified or unknown structure for military purposes"}
{"id": "e2788375-d6cf-4801-b1cf-764b1c964982", "value": "A rough shelter or dwelling, sometimes used to house cattle."}
{"id": "d9df885f-1da9-45ea-83a8-b328022fdcff", "value": "An inclined plane connecting two different levels, for use by vehicles."}
{"id": "f4e3d172-67ea-431d-a8d2-b10ef93b661f", "value": "An inclined concrete ramp on which cars can move from one level to another."}
{"id": "826326a5-c451-4cb5-8f41-09756f912fef", "value": "A place providing social, recreational, and educational facilities for a neighbourhood."}

skos:Concept.skos:altLabel: {"id": "dd2639f6-25d8-4d3d-94e7-55275756720e", "value": "SAFLE YMARFER TANIO A BOMIO O\u2019R AWYR"}
skos:Concept.skos:scopeNote: {"id": "04405da4-cb72-471b-882d-622d5e3c9f87", "value": "An area of land, with associated buildings and targets, used for practicing the dropping of bombs and other aspects of air warfare."}
{"id": "2829cb7b-c98d-4f11-a240-5dbc107c29d5", "value": "A piece of ground over which small arms or large artillery may be fired at targets. For rocket and missile firing use ROCKET TEST FACILITY."}
{"id": "362d9b7c-23f0-4c93-97d6-24cda60127c9", "value": "A mound or structure on which an archery, musketry or artillery target is erected. Use specific type where known."}

{"id": "d3c7884b-e12f-4871-ad23-7bb547865db0", "value": "Position from which small arms or larger artillery are shot at the targets on a firing range. These may be constructions of some height or may just have been marked on the ground. In some cases trenches are used."}

{"id": "6ad56d12-e3be-4dd0-8061-8d5070e248a1", "value": "An area for the testing of rockets and guided missiles. Includes all structures associated with both the firing and testing of rockets and missiles."}
{"id": "803f601e-3871-4bb4-b0f6-a4011ee70445", "value": "A deep pit used for the burial of plague victims."}
{"id": "afbc100e-af67-400c-acf8-0a9c891f5cc9", "value": "A hard level roadway or other surface from which aircraft take off and land."}
{"id": "e6664d17-05e0-4237-8e58-1f3c716790ee", "value": "A marked path along which aircraft taxi to or from a parking area, runway, etc."}
{"id": "bc0f8948-db1a-427d-aa3d-617b406a75c8", "value": "An area or site used for the landing and take-off of aircraft, often including associated buildings, equipment and other installations."}
{"id": "1c19d21e-e384-44f8-b8c0-109eb34be07e", "value": "One with no hangars; simply an anchorage point with ancillary structures."}
{"id": "ef26e050-862b-45f5-8a14-0a0b716ec1d7", "value": "A large shed for the housing of aircraft, etc."}
{"id": "ce89cb13-cfc6-4eb6-a9b1-389a88b56c7b", "value": "A site, including an airfield and customs house, where air passengers embark and disembark."}
{"id": "48312cd5-97ec-4528-9fca-aceb0761f3aa", "value": "A gate on a toll road where travellers had to pay a toll to the toll-keeper."}
{"id": "1a83013d-18d9-49cf-8a23-1226ba0a702b", "value": "A sign, situated near a road or bridge, indicating a toll."}
{"id": "c82f035e-9ef1-4234-8723-bc87acea8264", "value": "A road whose upkeep and repair was financed by the exaction of a toll."}
{"id": "da2dcd02-5268-4761-913c-1538ea0cb25d", "value": "A booth, shed or stall erected at the side of a road, canal, bridge or gate where a toll must be paid."}
{"id": "315dceb7-8eb3-4393-b1c6-01c09e7f4790", "value": "A house by a toll gate or toll bridge where tolls are collected."}

{"id": "065f6a42-a218-4f90-8c99-44f677a87c2b", "value": "A site where a building once stood as identified by a level area of ground, often compacted or made from man-made materials. Use only where specific function is unknown, otherwise use more specific term"}
{"id": "09e57d97-6e7f-4ce8-ae63-84ac7d89713f", "value": "Levelled or terraced area of ground presumed to have been the site of a house or hut."}
{"id": "094e5490-9ddf-4fb8-9b9a-213c15293a55", "value": "Anchoring points for climbers, usually consisting of lengths of angle iron projecting above ground and set in concrete close to cliff edge."}
{"id": "d5e00f1b-28a9-44f0-b1da-6ced4e763d03", "value": "Mine used for the extraction of pyrites (iron disulfide)."}
{"id": "5da82206-84b7-4255-9089-e7fa4c4b3faa", "value": "Buildings and structures associated with the manufacture of rope."}
{"id": "867d39f8-b4ff-425e-ad53-26829c23192b", "value": "A place where ropes are made."}

{"id": "bc7ad9f7-363f-4377-a717-abfd66349b9c", "value": "A very long, narrow, roofed building, often two-storeyed, used for the manufacture of rope. Often attached to warehousing, an engine house or offices. Can be included within the complex of a textile mill."}
{"id": "682118af-3e1f-4318-9d79-cc0e27950bb2", "value": "A warehouse used for the storage of fruit and/or vegetables."}
{"id": "a262e3d9-795f-4e76-bb08-6ce0d300b251", "value": "A building licensed for the sale of beer."}
{"id": "0b68d9f3-9756-4a0f-a8a2-f67f301b640e", "value": "A form of floating, moveable pier designed for use in open water."}
{"id": "5859863d-2714-44f3-9bbf-539413a10b85", "value": "A structure indicated by the presence of post holes and of uncertain interpretation."}
{"id": "e650c04a-0716-4e26-84e9-02d603bf2634", "value": "A bridge over a canal."}
{"id": "4248f1ac-581a-4850-a182-7acbfd2f8b4a", "value": "A bridge which takes a towing path over a branch canal, basin, etc."}
{"id": "9816a6de-78a8-4e68-89b5-5dae168f1d5a", "value": "A stone commemorating the date of a specific event."}

{"id": "3b4ff23a-bd1d-422c-8dcb-4ca367bf41fa", "value": "A tree named after a person or event associated with it."}

{"id": "b09c951d-3ab8-4298-a85e-ff0b1325c9a7", "value": "A simple type of bridge, composed of horizontal beams supported by vertical posts"}

{"id": "431e41e8-d0a3-4b4f-86fd-b45430999a0f", "value": "An enclosed ecclesiastical settlement of the early Christian period."}

{"id": "cd3f40e4-4d33-442d-b7b0-87add96cdcf3", "value": "A place where appropriate acts, rites and ceremonies are performed to honour or revere a supernatural being, power or holy entity. Use specific type where known."}

{"id": "fdcb2c2b-0d0c-4a33-9252-801ee789db22", "value": "A garden designed to provide living material for the study of botany and horticulture."}

{"id": "f8c91c70-3024-4cf2-8a1b-6779e92f882f", "value": "A concrete structure designed to be the headquarters for the coordination of an airfield's defences. Constructed partially underground it was only intended to be occupied during an attack."}

{"id": "ee60e782-67dc-47bc-b071-df5262402588", "value": "A site or building where silver was processed and/or worked and fashioned into objects."}

{"id": "dbdf8810-4350-45f8-b13d-9526af0c5dfe", "value": "A tall, tapering pillar with a pyramidal top, generally square on plan. Used in Britain from the late 16th century as a public, funerary or garden monument."}

{"id": "c07ca3cd-91f5-47e1-947e-dc537e48929f", "value": "A roughly circular monument featuring a low, more or less level platform of stones surrounded or retained by a low stone kerb. Some may feature a small central open area, thus resembling a ring cairn"}
{"id": "e7a9c883-bd4d-4407-b6ba-06bacdb61a79", "value": "A canopy or building to cover the platforms in a railway station."}
{"id": "431a4bb2-3236-419e-8500-ac893f90588f", "value": "A building, site or structure associated with various racing sports."}
{"id": "251ed7be-8c0d-4710-b043-9a7efee0f924", "value": "A piece of ground used for motor racing."}

{"id": "179b51e6-99f7-49ed-a397-301446d271d0", "value": "A racing track, often within a permanent stadium, for racing dogs, usually greyhounds and whippets."}
{"id": "621bed3d-38ea-483c-94b1-068241a7ac0a", "value": "A place where two or more railway lines meet."}
{"id": "5afddde7-8af4-415f-b393-c497c25cdc91", "value": "A building or site used for the production of bricks and other items, from a clay with refractory properties."}

{"id": "56541976-90f4-439d-aa7c-9b17dcfefd44", "value": "Sites and structures associated with the manufacture of bricks and tiles. Includes sites associated with earth extraction and preparation."}
{"id": "2530cec9-33de-435e-9917-fe9be059a984", "value": "A building or structure in which bricks are made."}
{"id": "9b2084b8-96eb-4eec-8007-b7e93164e7c7", "value": "A college where specialist skills, relating to a particular subject, are taught. Use specific type where known."}
{"id": "30f9b9ed-c90e-4c9c-97d8-873a56a4d565", "value": "A university or college building set apart for residence or instruction of students."}

{"id": "bbbb5fd9-8625-4a4a-8312-2165becde6d2", "value": "A building used, as a meeting place and administration block, by an organisation run for the benefit of students at a school, college or university."}
{"id": "055e8b8d-0361-41a1-a497-76cd67beb7a6", "value": "A group of colleges and associated buildings belonging to a university."}
{"id": "07a59e01-4fc9-4f51-9e8e-cb97ed22cddf", "value": "An office where the administrative duties of a university are performed."}
{"id": "4adc3cac-baa9-411c-a786-fd407e3b2841", "value": "A college associated with, or forming part of, a university."}
{"id": "71de11ae-50a0-44d6-8059-2285cf55d206", "value": "When a secondary mineral, use term for product type, eg. LEAD MINE."}
{"id": "83fd5527-3c63-4b2d-b898-9bb55198fc51", "value": "A mine used for the extraction of zinc bearing ore. Use with other metal ores extracted and MINE where necessary, eg. LEAD MINE."}
{"id": "9f78cf22-681e-4194-8f4f-49ddc0c86033", "value": "Use with other minerals extracted and MINE where relevant, eg. ZINC MINE."}

{"id": "28b7300a-07b3-4978-be87-0744fc47aa6a", "value": "The approximate location at which stray finds of artefacts were found."}

{"id": "892bded1-48d1-4316-921d-600e1d8a6771", "value": "The place where two motorways, or a motorway and a trunk road, meet each other and traffic from each are filtered onto the correct carraigeway."}

{"id": "48d5f39a-249a-4d31-b9cb-a71b90d49c80", "value": "An enclosure of stakes driven into the ground, sometimes for defensive purposes."}

{"id": "708ec1b5-80e8-424f-95b3-28a5cc5ec52b", "value": "A former beach which now lies above the high water mark because of changes in sea level or isostatic uplift."}

{"id": "c5abc77a-8a92-44bd-a391-3117b5909d1b", "value": "A structure which protects an area of ground from the weather."}
{"id": "c9cd2ba7-0d1b-4ee5-9bba-ecc3e7ef45f5", "value": "A layer of stone, brick or boards, etc, on which people tread. Use broader site type where known."}

{"id": "584336c8-d055-463e-92c6-fc6477e708d2", "value": "A mast carrying a wind gauge used to record wind speeds. Used to record wind speeds associated with wind farm developments."}
{"id": "ab079487-490e-4a5a-b1da-9d38a1a609fb", "value": "Unspecified. Use specific type where known."}
{"id": "97bc8a2f-e9ff-49be-a4f2-e9e31ea00874", "value": "An archaeological feature manifested by changes in the overlying crop. Use more specific term where possible."}
{"id": "32b73b23-7347-4b76-aaa0-ac0194bbe6bf", "value": "This is the top term for the class. See MONUMENT <BY FORM> Class list for narrow terms."}
{"id": "50145d93-a1d0-44a2-bcb3-11916321c884", "value": "An impression made in soft ground by a passing animal or human. The soft ground may have subsequently hardened."}

{"id": "26ca8862-919b-4075-8d3d-5bdf34ec64ac", "value": "The cable support structures located between the loading, unloading and angle stations of an aerial ropeway. These structures area slo known as stanchions or standards."}
{"id": "defad942-e45b-4b70-aea7-663c4bd1c39b", "value": "Small areas of indeterminate function."}
{"id": "7da26e80-f5ee-453e-92cd-6bf294310556", "value": "A modern building in which the load is carried by a metal girder framework and infilled with a light curtain wall."}
{"id": "a4bc1a96-cc36-4ea8-8989-70c215ac452b", "value": "A spatially discrete, though sometimes extensive, scatter of shells visible on the ground surface"}

{"id": "63101875-a936-46e2-abce-e06722f13d3d", "value": "A spatially discrete scatter of mixed artefactual material found on the ground, seabed or riverbed which may have been deposited over time rather than resulting from one particular event."}
{"id": "74a1b959-6aef-44b7-9c76-5a31c58dd8f1", "value": "A pair of round barrows which form a significant group"}
{"id": "ad411efa-73df-4cad-902e-4ee9dd2f9dd4", "value": "A bridge made up of many relatively small members joined together in a series of interconnecting triangles."}

{"id": "db8c3f83-076d-4135-a375-baeac8644ca8", "value": "A specialized form of truss bridge that extends or cantilevers from both sides of the pier, the inner 'arms' usually supporting a central span."}

{"id": "b6623839-c64b-40d3-91b5-f1dfec1ad0e0", "value": "A linear earthwork, usually a bank accompanied by a ditch, which runs across rather than along an area or ridge of higher ground."}

{"id": "d5a64cc1-b683-4ef1-b517-43c08130814e", "value": "A building used for the storage of explosives of a non-military function, eg. mining explosives, signal explosives etc."}
{"id": "2e539c2c-7fe1-4b37-bfc2-c918aee11f8b", "value": "Sites used for the manufacture of chemicals used as the basis for complex chemical processes or products."}
{"id": "082aa10d-3345-4792-9f05-f3f3073914f4", "value": "Buildings, sites and structures associated with the production, testing and storage of explosives."}
{"id": "fb8a014a-fc2c-4f41-a0b7-aae4536b1a64", "value": "Buildings, structures or sites used for the production of chemicals used in agriculture, such as fertilizers and weed killers."}
{"id": "851e2d26-7058-40d5-bd4d-f30eb0ac2796", "value": "A shed used for the storage of limestone prior to use in a lime kiln."}
{"id": "2a9f4e9f-c1bf-476e-97b6-28118b1d0115", "value": "A system of lights, controlled fires or dummy constructions, used during WWII to provide a counterfeit target for enemy aircraft."}
{"id": "5e070b07-1031-4ef1-babf-e356d084052f", "value": "A settlement in a rural context which has been abandoned, usually in the medieval period."}
{"id": "4657e6ca-701a-41f1-87b7-01a1361d6fa3", "value": "A temporary earthwork or fortification constructed by forces laying siege to a castle or town, etc."}
{"id": "401114ad-7467-4af2-8792-ffe8f503d113", "value": "An indoor or outdoor market where fruit and vegetables are sold."}
{"id": "cfd06347-263c-4a25-b01e-01bdae1ded87", "value": "Circular enclosure featuring an enclosing bank with no accompanying ditch. Use specific type where known."}
{"id": "33e82ace-02b9-4436-b5dc-162f2908973f", "value": "The administrative office of a commercial concern."}
{"id": "b5cc4487-aa9e-45f3-8acb-5904abf70968", "value": "An office for the administration of town or country estates."}
{"id": "3934c246-cc96-4bd0-91c7-3fd1466afad7", "value": "A building or set of rooms where a newspaper is compiled and produced, before being printed. May include facilities for printing."}
{"id": "a9bb5e2a-58ce-473b-a4f8-10669830675b", "value": "A commercial building used for the production of detailed, often technical, drawings."}
{"id": "7c10103d-111c-4390-990e-1e9795b2d4e7", "value": "A pond used for the rearing, breeding, sorting and storing of fish."}
{"id": "9ded811a-2170-422c-8d99-f8c4418e8b83", "value": "A tower serving as a reservoir to deliver water at a required point."}
{"id": "656fff9f-28de-427c-94b4-296f61b11df8", "value": "A building over a well housing machinery for raising the water. Often consisting of a DONKEY WHEEL or HORSE GIN."}
{"id": "5aaf3d25-11e4-4d2a-ae2e-ec29fe26a07c", "value": "Buildings, engineering constructions and machinery, used for the purpose of supplying a town, etc, with water distributed through pipes."}
{"id": "6e34df24-5fc9-40cb-8375-c2a97b6120bb", "value": "A shaft or pit dug in the ground over a supply of spring-water."}
{"id": "d0ac85ef-b0e8-401d-92b2-1767e7fd5af4", "value": "Regional court or administrative centre of a Welsh Prince."}
{"id": "7753c8e2-ccc0-4cf9-a377-b2862b961980", "value": "A district, suburb or quarter of a town or village adjacent to a fort, with the lowest legal status accorded to a built up area."}

{"id": "b7fb4408-3167-4917-b52a-d5b66aa8c90f", "value": "Mark, usually consisting of a horizontal line above an arrow, cut by the Ordnance Survey as part of the survey of Britain and referenced to a known height above mean sea level."}
{"id": "b6dd83f9-a3e7-4aa3-9cef-97546d0c1381", "value": "The premises of a police officer for a parish or township who was appointed to act as a conservator of the peace within the district."}
{"id": "d0be97dc-1bb8-415b-a5c8-def38d35cb51", "value": "A building used for the dissemination to the public of such items like tourist brochures, travel maps, guide books and other documents, etc."}

{"id": "83323097-ab84-4ab6-bc4b-951f756411f0", "value": "An aisled timber or masonry hall, serving as the chief administrative public meeting centre and law courts for a Roman town. Usually located alongside the forum."}
{"id": "c5f0f6f8-5cb4-48d2-9a1a-d811327992ee", "value": "A civic building housing fire engines and a permanent fire-fighting force."}
{"id": "ac790346-c564-4ae2-8a1c-4ebd5d74ae2f", "value": "A purpose-built triangulation point used for the metrical survey of Britain carried out by the Ordnance Survey."}
{"id": "69b0132b-9da0-4cdf-a287-528fd05ab08b", "value": "A type of Roman lodging house, frequently sited near the town gate."}
{"id": "d6f68407-9bd5-4aea-ab6c-a360a2d8d30b", "value": "A large, rectangular open space at the centre of a Roman town, incorporating public spaces and a market area."}
{"id": "b1bd8bc7-66be-4b26-97ea-6d5eb5cd0efb", "value": "An employment exchange for unemployed labourers, servicemen, etc."}
{"id": "540a7901-57b9-40e0-b5c4-8e276b537870", "value": "A building in which a parliament meets and conducts the business of government."}
{"id": "41f09a5f-6b67-4a98-ae63-fc74eee3ed5b", "value": "A place where money is coined under public authority."}
{"id": "b602f6c1-0143-443d-bec0-5efd467e46f9", "value": "This is the top term for the class. See CIVIL Class List for narrow terms."}
{"id": "6bb9a42c-de38-451e-85e0-5112977118c3", "value": "A group of standing stones which do not form any recognizable pattern."}

{"id": "123bb4a5-625b-44a6-b043-b8b0369e87c3", "value": "A defensive enclosure created by constructing one or more lines of ramparts across a neck of land, in order to defend, or restrict access to, a spur or promontory, either inland or on the coast."}

{"id": "abc15253-f6ab-46f4-85c4-6a9aeade4a30", "value": "A market where cattle, pigs, sheep and poultry are bought and sold."}

{"id": "a74778f8-a832-4d84-8799-8b8997bf3e3e", "value": "A settlement without any obvious evidence for a boundary. Use specific type where known."}

{"id": "5be66905-b2f5-4157-a580-44fb2087ea41", "value": "A large, usually landscaped, garden associated with a country house."}

{"id": "fbf574ba-39d9-4340-a592-6fea9da41fbd", "value": "A levelled area of ground, circular in shape, used as the base on which a monument was built.Sometimes raised, a platform is often the sole surviving evidence for a monument."}
{"id": "68216949-a165-4e57-998c-933a01bd15e7", "value": "An enclosed field for horses."}
{"id": "a6db693f-c6c6-4c2e-970a-966eabe34d73", "value": "A communal residence of secular vicars whose duties included the education of choristers attached to cathedrals and collegiate churches."}
{"id": "aaea1bcf-6e0d-49ce-ad94-6b4d642754a3", "value": "A series of open strip fields marked off from each other merely by boundary stones"}
{"id": "1d2a9e9c-c972-4be4-b5ad-045b72ea1d7c", "value": "A small workshop, employing up to 10 men, working on hand-operated carding engines and hand jennies, spinning yarn for handloom weavers."}
{"id": "287ef79e-104a-43cc-8740-6c06e70bdfdc", "value": "A site used for the extraction and purification of salt, usually by the dehydration of brine."}
{"id": "73185801-abb5-4774-8072-a7d62ff9d52f", "value": "A structure built to provide refuge for shipwrecked sailors. Often provisioned with foodstuffs and other items for aid and comfort."}
{"id": "818cc98a-c732-4477-ad0b-72b81483ad02", "value": "A block for mounting a horse."}
{"id": "3375e99a-161a-4c42-b659-a01c62b547c0", "value": "A wooden, metal or stone post used to tether a horse, or other animals."}

{"id": "759ac187-33c0-4773-8906-a5d1505a68f5", "value": "A site comprising a system of lights, controlled fires or dummy constructions, used during WWII to provide a counterfeit target for enemy aircraft. Use more specific type where known."}
{"id": "b6e08ade-ab83-41f5-b7bd-4a752f390528", "value": "A plate, usually of wood or metal, used to indicate the limit of an area or piece of land."}
{"id": "90d3d82e-1ad2-4bd6-b5e1-eb9f87b6918b", "value": "A cairn used to indicate the limit of an area or a piece of land."}
{"id": "011aa181-3f49-4fcb-9d61-b602e1fe1181", "value": "A complex maze incorporating tall hedges. A popular feature of 16th and 17th century gardens."}
{"id": "50e12dda-694a-440c-83c3-57138353ca7d", "value": "A garden of regular, linear or geometrical design, often associated with the traditional Italian, French and Dutch styles."}
{"id": "133a0d6e-1910-4bc1-a780-d25d3adeef35", "value": "A large metal pylon structure used to tether airships."}
{"id": "0d8c6d2e-1dc5-4a9f-9f6b-18a554b2b16b", "value": "A quay used for fitting-out vessels."}
{"id": "af678115-f618-4021-949f-36c44ab77800", "value": "A building containing facilities for washing the person."}
{"id": "30ebb683-2b0b-4f6d-b709-80a2b2ea5a69", "value": "A building for the storage of ammunition and other military stores."}
{"id": "72b5afee-0127-4476-8653-f56f4acb841e", "value": "A structure, usually or concrete or sandbags, in which a machine gun was emplaced."}

{"id": "62c434bf-bcd4-4799-8121-fff9199fac79", "value": "A sunken, circular, concrete pillbox used on airfields. They remained flush with the surface to permit the free movement of aircraft, but if attack threatened, could be raised, hydraulically or by a counterbalance, and manned to give covering fire."}
{"id": "0152c86e-37a4-4b23-ac06-39d1fb7042a9", "value": "A building or structure used for storing food. Use more specific term where appropriate."}
{"id": "70b34a47-c677-48db-aa35-611791406d78", "value": "A site where vinegar is manufactured from soured beer, wine or cider."}
{"id": "0554c32d-fd23-4392-9b79-0554ababde3a", "value": "A school where young children, usually under the age of seven, are taught."}
{"id": "efcfa71c-a326-4e90-8fac-b969a347102e", "value": "A largely residential area on the outskirts of a town or city."}
{"id": "4509a898-220a-4954-88c7-54693dd74eb6", "value": "A garden devoted to the growth of vegetables."}
{"id": "a7d3dee1-32c3-4e47-b8c4-aa54ad061ff3", "value": "Workshop in which metal welding, fabrication and repairs are carried out"}
{"id": "89f865ae-d805-409e-8599-ce6a32240ce1", "value": "Buildings, sites and structures associated with the extraction of clay."}
{"id": "1fedb6f2-d070-4bd6-b694-e0233384b3e1", "value": "A mound or structure on which targets are placed for archery practice or competition."}
{"id": "8a08d1d2-e044-4f89-9b3c-996e9a30008c", "value": "The junction of two or more trackways"}

{"id": "2ce21f17-9162-4990-8527-1cf58b426ec5", "value": "A square pillbox with loopholes for four Light Machine Guns and walls 18in thick. Probably designed by DFW branch 3 although it may have been adapted from an external source as Southern Command correspondence refer to the type as 'Stento'."}
{"id": "43774861-6b66-47e6-9b3c-22fbee484f50", "value": "An arena for bull-baiting, not a tethering ring."}
{"id": "dc824606-2d63-468c-adc9-15d5a159bc69", "value": "A boundary enclosing a precinct, often used in a monastic context."}
{"id": "9f3af586-81cb-48bc-89aa-b3147687cebf", "value": "A works where bleach is manufactured."}
{"id": "4edaf76f-f316-4638-a800-eae80caf5574", "value": "A quay constructed from ships' ballast."}

{"id": "6d5fddd4-eca9-4c27-9680-23a640cc7d84", "value": "A spatially discrete, though sometimes extensive, scatter of lithic artefacts recovered from the surface, eg. by fieldwalking, rather than from a particular archaeological context. Use particular types where appropriate."}
{"id": "441721af-a063-4f17-84d4-998ad84ea47c", "value": "An engineered drive constructed to allow the passage of carriages."}

{"id": "d396a40d-6b92-4004-8dd4-b6b91302338c", "value": "A circular pillbox, usually consisting of a concrete pipe with a timber and corrugated iron roof, surrounded and covered by earth and sandbags. Built to a design by Norcon Ltd, a company dealing in concrete pipes."}
{"id": "1a50d33f-28ab-4bbb-82d4-f65eec35b29a", "value": "A series of spoil heaps covering an extensive area, possibly with associated tramways."}
{"id": "df081958-160d-4748-adfb-70b99025b78e", "value": "A garden where woodland and meadow flowers grow in an apparently natural way."}
{"id": "c88b5a8a-f687-481f-9d82-a9473555fa69", "value": "An incline that uses a counter balance system between the cars or trams for raising and lowering."}
{"id": "c5872968-bb98-46a4-8f0c-24f6f53e0f2f", "value": "An incline that uses water and the force of gravity for raising and lowering."}
{"id": "a93aa7f5-49b4-49a0-9bbf-2668c6a10b4a", "value": "A licenced establishment where wine and other alcoholic drinks are sold for drinking on the premises."}
{"id": "04517fa6-b0e0-4942-93bd-31e2dbf87128", "value": "A belt of trees planted to provide protection for livestock in exposed areas."}
{"id": "7e81c80b-cad8-48d9-9a2f-a47b75e7ff25", "value": "An arena used for horse dressage."}
{"id": "3c9dbed0-29f3-4429-90ff-c1e073927e4a", "value": "An observation post used by the Home Guard."}
{"id": "13339b72-f3b9-4885-99a1-4668ca2dc988", "value": "A structure made out of wood. Use more specific term where known."}

{"id": "c7e8f3a7-2062-4de1-b02c-5f505516e9e5", "value": "Garden comprising rockwork features including grottoes, cascades and arches, often in different architectural styles ie. Gothic, Chinese and rustic. In use from the mid C18."}
{"id": "8887b85a-89b6-44af-8036-e7652713d75a", "value": "A club founded to provide education, relaxation, and recreation for working men."}
{"id": "104e2da0-6b8c-4b8c-bbd4-f41da69e1660", "value": "A place where railway trains stop on request for taking up and setting down passengers or for receiving goods for transport."}
{"id": "8d30f0b9-3a8a-4ced-8ce5-5ce60c24bd93", "value": "A building or site used for the manufacture of pins."}
{"id": "247ad455-5a22-4799-8e50-c0b413a6ef13", "value": "A factory where explosives and the components of munitions of all types are brought together for assembly."}
{"id": "0b30fbaa-3772-4030-8bd6-37515e1e47fa", "value": "A shelter located in a quarry, often used by workers to process raw materials."}
{"id": "09292240-52ba-4f73-b093-108d5a829d9c", "value": "A lake used for the storage of a large body of water for use in various industrial processes."}
{"id": "8ec4396b-7dce-4284-bfc0-81f392707a4b", "value": "A hard standing on which an engine was placed. Often contains features for attaching the engine to the base."}

{"id": "8e47d0e9-f12c-4c5e-a0c8-fb7fab7a742c", "value": "A building or group of buildings containing equipment capable of transmitting and receiving radio signals. Use BROADCASTING RADIO STATION for broadcasting establishments e.g. BBC Radio stations."}
{"id": "626d3e41-c4b9-4fc0-b915-605181b1383a", "value": "The location where a submarine cable reaches land. Usually marked on navigation maops, and often marked by a warning post."}

skos:Concept.skos:scopeNote: {"id": "63066aa6-1c5e-4a88-931c-570689135c5a", "value": "A chamber built into the side of a covered reservoir to enable the water level to be inspected."}

{"id": "e86cbbb9-b1c6-492e-9fb0-4660aecbfa3e", "value": "A building where employees are searched onm their way in or out of work. Often used on industrial sites to prevent items such as matches and lighters being taken into areas where combistable is likely to be present."}
{"id": "e3b6ca0b-2db1-40f6-bebf-6d3750ee967c", "value": "An embanked shute, often stone paved, allowing carts to tip their loads of coal from the road into a storage area."}
{"id": "986b421d-a2f9-4ac8-8c24-26167b8abfd6", "value": "A wall built to retain a bank of earth."}
{"id": "eba0d558-2bea-4f7e-8bb9-881cb3311e57", "value": "A shed in which life saving apparatus is stored."}
{"id": "fa963a70-e332-4cd7-9c5c-a77790f63775", "value": "A room or group of rooms usually below the ground level and usually under a building, often used for storing fuel, provisions or wines."}
{"id": "5e9f9493-3c40-46c6-852a-062e9a2e9e6b", "value": "A factory where sheets of iron, and later rolled steel strip, receive a coating of tin"}
{"id": "a783aff4-9245-41bf-bd99-227d580f36ee", "value": "An area of ground managed by municipal authorities, set apart for the burial of the dead."}
{"id": "3845c86d-1541-4d1a-abfa-4e92cae846bb", "value": "A hut constructed from corbelled stone."}
{"id": "95696875-3c4c-4bb0-9427-f981339097fd", "value": "A light, often suspended from a lamp-post, to illuminate a street or road."}
{"id": "4b7f89f9-7ec2-4fb2-86b0-9a5a069e6896", "value": "A stone-built structure close to a lime kiln, in which the limeburners would take shelter."}
{"id": "438b5f63-eac7-4c7f-b496-49768b3cfe36", "value": "Access track linking runways around the outside of an airfield."}
{"id": "aaf5962d-924f-4c5c-9dd2-f2081ba6d6f8", "value": "A man-made trough or valley through a hill, carrying at its base a road."}
{"id": "d6fee22b-b1c7-4851-8a3f-27869a680720", "value": "A building, or complex of buildings, dedicated to the production of milk churns."}
{"id": "444ba001-a811-4ac9-b6a3-af6d929563f8", "value": "A garden maintained for the study and cultivation of plants for medicinal purposes."}
{"id": "36489699-3e31-480c-8abd-1ad89713f62b", "value": "A scooped piece of ground to provide the base for a hut."}
{"id": "15b892e6-6bee-47ad-9050-e4e8bc3fad3b", "value": "A series of associated clearance cairns forming a discrete group."}
{"id": "629fbbce-a648-4e9e-8a3f-a92a20d17336", "value": "An educational establishment where agricultural theory and practice is taught."}
{"id": "839f98d6-969f-48d2-87f1-41aa10391911", "value": "A plant used for stamping low grade ore prior to processing."}

{"id": "2a38f2d9-b171-4af4-849b-04ad3906960c", "value": "A hexagonal pillbox with an internal anti-ricochet wall and the rear wall lengthened to take two rifle loopholes in addition to five Light Machine Gun loopholes. Both 15in and 42in thick walls are common. Designed by DFW branch 3."}
{"id": "a5e22e23-8402-4531-aa1d-2bc155385d57", "value": "A place where a number of coins have been discovered, either as the result of loss or deliberate deposit."}
{"id": "50df36cd-29c4-4db3-b807-9782df3d5fae", "value": "A place where employees are clocked in and out of work."}
{"id": "457e74e2-2b46-4a55-bda5-372b4212a8c3", "value": "An often secluded garden set below the level of surrounding ground, usually surrounded with terraces."}
{"id": "79e85f2e-e450-4313-b489-280bc094ef7a", "value": "A quarry where iron stone is extracted."}
{"id": "87882252-fc14-4cfb-8fb7-9af27f21df1e", "value": "An informal garden attached to a cottage where flowers, vegetables and fruit trees are grown."}
{"id": "8f06e210-edda-4a89-bdb2-7c4523c4b256", "value": "A point where water issues naturally from the rock or soil onto the ground or into a body of surface water."}
{"id": "288cb2ee-4b4a-42cd-89b9-975764bf08ac", "value": "An elongated field which is a relict of a former open field system"}
{"id": "eaa8a9a9-8fca-4e3d-aa08-a379d28d721e", "value": "A cluster of closely spaced chambered tombs."}
{"id": "557737d2-6d9e-436c-8f2b-35ba91da0c04", "value": "Engineering workshop used for the final assembly of vehicles or structures from parts produced elsewhere in an engineering works."}
{"id": "bf051668-714d-439d-96b2-a356615fc443", "value": "An enclosed settlement surrounded by a single or double row of close-set timbers embedded in a foundation trench, without ditches or banks."}
{"id": "8847434a-1394-4545-87ec-22431b9fd0bb", "value": "A structure in which pottery tiles were baked."}
{"id": "795da525-8160-4837-9f8b-0256e4de12a6", "value": "A painting or mural executed directly onto a wall."}
{"id": "9b9293ad-a5ed-42ca-90d1-659eaf0ec8e8", "value": "An unspecified building associated with a railway station; use specific type where known"}
{"id": "66924bdc-c917-450c-9509-0b7d0a9a6658", "value": "An earthwork bank often used for protection from noise."}
{"id": "3b080795-d099-4269-9be9-9c2623ee42d9", "value": "A grave used for the inhumation of a large number of corpses."}
{"id": "98228dfb-7146-4303-9a43-75548f4dc2f7", "value": "A soft, marshy garden, often peat-based where water- and peat-loving plants are grown."}
{"id": "724dd492-e0db-44f8-9004-ab01fb78e27e", "value": "A town where the economy and character of the town is dominated by tourism."}
